trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference dimension listing European football divisions/leagues. Grain: one record per division code; no season or date attributes are present, implying a static lookup. The primary join key is division, used to link to related fact tables that track matches or seasons.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: division. division also functions as a foreign key in other tables (target table Unknown). No time grain or SCD behavior indicated; attributes appear static. Text fields are free-text with no specified code standard.

columns.columnDescription: Division/competition code (text) that uniquely identifies a league. Serves as the primary key here and a foreign key in related tables (target Unknown).
Official name of the division/league (text).
Country associated with the division (text). Format Unknown (name vs. code not specified).

trainingdata.tableDescription: Association football match facts at full-time. Grain: one row per match (home team vs away team) within a division on a specific calendar date and season; score and outcome reflect full-time only. Time scope: day-level via Date, with a Season indicator; historical coverage Unknown. Key joins: Div (league/division code) is a foreign key; a common natural key is Div + Date + HomeTeam + AwayTeam.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: one record per completed match at full-time. Time grain: Date is day-level (no kickoff time provided); Season is an additional season indicator. Joins: Div is a foreign key to a division/league reference table (target Unknown). Suggested natural key: Div + Date + HomeTeam + AwayTeam. Units: FTHG and FTAG are integer goal counts at full-time; FTR codes H=home win, D=draw, A=away win. No SCD behavior indicated.

columns.columnDescription: League/division code for the competition the match belongs to. Foreign key; target table Unknown.
Calendar date of the match (day-level). No time-of-day provided.
Name of the home club (hosting side).
Name of the away/visiting club.
Home team goals at full-time (end of regular play). Integer count, e.g., 0, 1, 2.
Away team goals at full-time (end of regular play). Integer count, e.g., 0, 1, 2.
Full-time result code: H=home win, D=draw, A=away win. Examples: H, D, A.
Competition season indicator. Exact format Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Item-level sales by store and date. Grain is one row per date x store_nbr x item_nbr (daily). Time coverage: Unknown.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: daily. Natural/composite key: date + store_nbr + item_nbr. FK: store_nbr references a store/location dimension (target table: Unknown). Join keys commonly used: store_nbr, item_nbr, date. Units column is a count of items (pieces). No SCD behavior noted.

columns.columnDescription: Calendar date of the sale at daily grain (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: 2017-06-15.
Integer identifier of the retail location. Foreign key to a store dimension; target table: Unknown. Examples: 1, 28, 345.
Integer identifier of the product/SKU sold at the store. Examples: 101, 2045, 98765.
Quantity of items sold for the store-item on the given date; integer count of pieces. Examples: 0, 5, 42.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Daily weather observations by station. Entity: a weather measurement recorded at a specific station on a specific calendar date; grain: one row per station_nbr per date. Time scope: calendar date in 'date'. Key join keys: station_nbr (to station reference, target Unknown) and date for aligning with other daily facts.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain is daily by station: one record per station_nbr per date. Join guidance: station_nbr is a foreign key to a station dimension/entity (target table Unknown); combine with date for daily joins. Units for temperature, pressure, wind, precipitation, and snowfall are not documented (Unknown); avoid mixing with other unit systems without verification. sunrise and sunset are text; format/timezone Unknown—parse cautiously. No SCD behavior indicated. Joins: sales_in_weather.weather.station_nbr → sales_in_weather.relation.station_nbr.

columns.columnDescription: Numeric identifier of the weather station reporting the observation. Foreign key to a station entity (target table: Unknown). Use with date as the natural daily key. FK to 'sales_in_weather.relation.station_nbr'.
Calendar date of the weather observation (daily grain). Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
Daily maximum air temperature. Units: Unknown; integer suggests whole-unit rounding.
Daily minimum air temperature. Units: Unknown.
Daily average air temperature across the day. Units and averaging method: Unknown.
Temperature difference from the location/date normal (observed minus normal). Units: Unknown.
Dew point temperature representative of the day. Units: Unknown.
Wet-bulb temperature representative of the day. Units: Unknown.
Heating degree day value for the date. Units/base: Unknown.
Cooling degree day value for the date. Units/base: Unknown.
Sunrise time at the station on the given date, stored as text. Format/timezone: Unknown (e.g., 06:33).
Sunset time at the station on the given date, stored as text. Format/timezone: Unknown (e.g., 19:48).
Summary of daily weather phenomena encoded as short codes. Coding scheme and possible values: Unknown.
Total snowfall amount for the day. Units: Unknown; decimal measurement.
Total daily precipitation (liquid-equivalent). Units: Unknown; decimal measurement.
Atmospheric pressure measured at the station elevation. Units: Unknown.
Sea-level adjusted atmospheric pressure. Units: Unknown.
Resultant (vector) wind speed aggregated over the day. Units: Unknown.
Resultant (vector) wind direction aggregated over the day. Units: Unknown.
Average wind speed across the day. Units: Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Store-to-weather-station relationship for the sales_in_weather domain. Grain: one record per store_nbr mapping to a station_nbr; no time columns are present. Join keys: store_nbr to the store master and station_nbr to the weather station reference.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: store_nbr. Foreign keys: store_nbr -> store dimension (target: Unknown); station_nbr -> weather station reference (target: Unknown). Grain: 1 row per store. No time fields; integrate with dated sales and weather fact tables via these keys. Joins: sales_in_weather.relation.store_nbr → sales_in_weather.sales_in_weather.store_nbr; sales_in_weather.relation.station_nbr → sales_in_weather.weather.station_nbr.

columns.columnDescription: Integer identifier of the retail store. Primary key of this table and a foreign key to the store master (target table: Unknown); use to join store-level facts. FK to 'sales_in_weather.sales_in_weather.store_nbr'.

Integer identifier of the associated weather station for the store. Foreign key to a weather station reference table (target: Unknown); use to join weather measurements for the mapped station. FK to 'sales_in_weather.weather.station_nbr'.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Brewery dimension: one row per brewery entity with basic identifying and location attributes. Grain is the brewery level; no explicit time fields are present, so treat values as current attributes. The primary join key within the craftbeer database is id.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: id (INTEGER). One row per brewery. No foreign keys declared in this table. No time grain columns; treat as a current snapshot. Location fields are free text; state may appear as a code or full region name.

columns.columnDescription: Unique integer identifier for a brewery. Primary key and standard join key at the brewery grain.
Official name of the brewery as free text (e.g., “Acme Brewing Co”). May include suffixes like Brewery, Brewing Co, LLC.
City or town where the brewery is located. Free-text municipality name.
Subnational region for the brewery location (state/province/region). May be a code (e.g., CA) or full name.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Catalog of beer products from breweries. Grain: one row per beer produced by a single brewery; no time dimension present. Key joins: id is the beer primary key; brewery_id links each beer to its brewery.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: id. brewery_id links to the brewery entity (target table not provided). Units: abv is percent (e.g., 5.5 = 5.5%), ibu is International Bitterness Units, ounces is US fluid ounces. No SCD or date fields; grain is per beer.

columns.columnDescription: Unique beer identifier (primary key). Integer ID for each beer record.
Identifier of the producing brewery. Foreign key to the brewery entity (target table: Unknown).
Alcohol content by volume, in percent. Examples: 4.5, 7.2 (meaning 4.5% or 7.2% ABV).
Bitterness measure on the IBU scale (higher = more bitter). Examples: 15, 45, 80.
Beer name as labeled by the brewery. Examples: IPA names, seasonal releases, or flagship brands.
Beer style or category designated by the brewery. Examples: IPA, Stout, Pilsner, Wheat, Porter.
Package volume in US fluid ounces (oz). Common values include 12, 16, 19.2, 22.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference dimension for batting style/handedness. Entity: batting style. Grain: one row per Batting_Id. Time scope: static reference (no dates tracked). Key join key: Batting_Id.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Batting_Id. Batting_Id is also flagged as a foreign key; target table Unknown. Join to related fact or entity tables on Batting_Id when present. No slowly changing dimensions indicated; values are static reference text.

columns.columnDescription: Surrogate integer identifier for the batting style record. Also a foreign key to a related table (target Unknown). Use this key for joins on Batting_Id.
Handedness of the batter. Typical values: Right-hand/Right (RHB), Left-hand/Left (LHB), or Ambidextrous.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Lookup of bowling styles/skills. Entity: bowling style record; grain: one row per Bowling_Id; no time scope indicated. Join via Bowling_Id, which is the primary key and also a foreign key (FK target: Unknown).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Bowling_Id. Bowling_Id is also a foreign key (target table Unknown). Grain: 1 row per Bowling_Id. No time dimension or units beyond free-text labels. SCD: Unknown.

columns.columnDescription: Unique identifier of the bowling style record (integer). Primary key; also a foreign key to another table (FK target: Unknown). Use to join from/to related entities.
Text label describing the bowling style/skill. Examples/values: Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference entity for cities used in the soccer_2016 database. Grain: one row per city; no explicit time attributes (time scope: Unknown). Key joins: City_Id is the primary key; Country_id links each city to its parent country.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: City_Id. City_Id is flagged as a foreign key in the source; target table Unknown. Outbound join: Country_id to a country/master country table (target table Unknown). No date columns; behaves as a static reference (no SCD noted). City_Name may not be unique—use City_Id for joins. Joins: soccer_2016.City.City_Id → soccer_2016.Venue.City_Id.

columns.columnDescription: Integer surrogate identifier for the city entity. Primary key of soccer_2016.City; also marked as a foreign key in the source (FK target Unknown). Positive integer. FK to 'soccer_2016.Venue.City_Id'.
Human-readable name of the city. Text label; not guaranteed unique; language/locale Unknown.
Integer identifier of the country that the city belongs to; intended join key to a country table (target Unknown).

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference list of countries used across the soccer_2016 database. Grain: one row per country. Primary key is Country_Id; use it to join from related tables that carry Country_Id. No explicit temporal attributes; treat as a static lookup (time scope unknown).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: 1 row per country. Primary key: Country_Id. Join on Country_Id from other tables that include Country_Id to enrich with country names (FK target: soccer_2016.Country). Time scope: Unknown; no effective/expiry dates or timestamps present.

columns.columnDescription: Integer surrogate identifier for a country. Primary key of soccer_2016.Country and FK target for related tables that reference Country_Id; use as the join key. Examples: 1, 33.
Human-readable country name. Examples: Brazil, Germany, Spain. Not guaranteed unique; rely on Country_Id for joins.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference list of extra types in the soccer_2016 schema. Entity: extra type; grain: one row per extra type identifier. No time scope implied (no date/time columns). Join to fact/detail tables via Extra_Id to retrieve the human-readable name.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Extra_Id. Use Extra_Id to join from other soccer_2016 tables that carry the same key to get Extra_Name. No time grain or effective-dating columns; treat as a static lookup.

columns.columnDescription: Integer identifier for an extra type; primary key of Extra_Type and join key used by related tables in soccer_2016. Examples: 1, 2, 3.
Text label for the extra type (free-form name). Examples depend on dataset; exact values Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Per-ball extra runs recorded within a match innings in an over-based bat-and-ball game (cricket context implied by overs/innings). Each row captures the number of extra runs awarded on a specific ball of an over, optionally categorized by an extra type for that ball and innings.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: one record per Match_Id + Innings_No + Over_Id + Ball_Id (+ Extra_Type_Id when categorized). Units: Extra_Runs is counted in runs (non-negative integers). Joins: Extra_Type_Id is a foreign key to an extra-type lookup table (exact table name unknown). Event alignment with ball/over detail tables, if present, typically uses Match_Id + Innings_No + Over_Id + Ball_Id. No slowly changing dimensions noted.

columns.columnDescription: Match identifier for linking to match-level or delivery-level data. Acts as a key component when joining ball/over events for the same game.
Over identifier within the innings. Use with Match_Id and Innings_No to locate the over in which the extra occurred.
Ball (delivery) sequence within the over. Combine with Match_Id, Innings_No, and Over_Id to pinpoint the exact ball for the extra.
Foreign key to the extra-type lookup (exact target table: Unknown). Indicates the category of extra awarded on the ball (e.g., wide, no-ball, bye, leg-bye, penalty).
Count of runs awarded as extras on the specified ball (for the given Extra_Type_Id if present). Unit: runs; examples: 0, 1, 2.
Innings sequence number within the match. Use with Match_Id to group overs and balls into the same innings (e.g., 1, 2, ...).

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference dimension listing the 'out' categories used in the soccer_2016 database. Grain: one row per out type; no inherent time scope. Join key is Out_Id, which is referenced as a foreign key by other tables (exact targets Unknown).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules:
- Primary key: Out_Id.
- Out_Id is also referenced as a foreign key in other tables (FK targets: Unknown).
- Grain: one record per out type; no time attributes.
- Acts as a static lookup (no SCD behavior noted).

columns.columnDescription: Integer identifier for the out type. Serves as the table’s primary key and is used as a foreign key in related tables (FK target: Unknown).
Display name/label of the out type. Examples: Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Lookup of outcome categories for the soccer_2016 dataset. Grain: one row per distinct outcome type; not time-bound. Primary key is Outcome_Id, which is the join key referenced by other tables that denote an outcome.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Outcome_Id. Join from referencing tables on Outcome_Id. No time columns; not an SCD.

columns.columnDescription: Integer surrogate key for an outcome category; primary key of this table. Example values: 1, 2, 3.
Text label naming the outcome category. Examples unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference table of player entities for the soccer_2016 database. Grain: one row per player, containing identifying attributes (name, DOB) plus integer foreign keys to lookup tables (targets unknown). Time scope: static attributes; effective period unknown.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Player_Id. Foreign keys: Batting_hand -> lookup (unknown target), Bowling_skill -> lookup (unknown target), Country_Name -> country lookup (unknown target). Grain: 1 row per player. DOB is a calendar date; no SCD/effective-dating fields observed. Joins: soccer_2016.Player.Player_Id → soccer_2016.Player_Match.Player_Id; soccer_2016.Player.Batting_hand → soccer_2016.Batting_Style.Batting_hand; soccer_2016.Player.Bowling_skill → soccer_2016.Bowling_Style.Bowling_skill; soccer_2016.Player.Country_Name → soccer_2016.Country.Country_Name.

columns.columnDescription: Integer identifier for the player entity. Primary key of soccer_2016.Player; also used as a join key to related tables (foreign key targets unknown). FK to 'soccer_2016.Player_Match.Player_Id'.
Full name of the player as text.
Player’s date of birth (calendar date).
Unknown. Integer code; foreign key to a handedness lookup (target unknown). FK to 'soccer_2016.Batting_Style.Batting_hand'.
Unknown. Integer code; foreign key to a bowling skill/type lookup (target unknown). FK to 'soccer_2016.Bowling_Style.Bowling_skill'.

Foreign key to a country reference (target unknown). Stores the player’s country identifier; despite the name, the value is an integer ID, not the country text. FK to 'soccer_2016.Country.Country_Name'.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Lookup of role entities used in the soccer_2016 database. Grain: one row per role (Role_Id). No explicit time scope; treat as a static reference.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Role_Id. Role_Id is also used as a foreign key in related tables; exact FK targets: Unknown. No effective/expiration dates; not an SCD. Role_Desc is free-text with no units. Joins: soccer_2016.Rolee.Role_Id → soccer_2016.Player_Match.Role_Id.

columns.columnDescription: Integer identifier for a role; unique per role. Join key to/from related tables on Role_Id. FK target: Unknown. FK to 'soccer_2016.Player_Match.Role_Id'.
Human-readable name/description of the role (text string).

trainingdata.tableDescription: Season-level entity with one record per competition season. Captures the season year and identifiers for key season awards (Man_of_the_Series, Orange_Cap, Purple_Cap). Grain: one row per Season_Id/Season_Year; join to related facts via Season_Id.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Season_Id. Season_Id is also flagged as a foreign key; FK target: Unknown. Time grain: one row per season (annual). Award fields are integer identifiers (IDs), not names. No SCD behavior noted. Joins: soccer_2016.Season.Season_Id → soccer_2016.Match.Season_Id.

columns.columnDescription: Unique season identifier (integer). Primary key for this table and also marked as a foreign key in the schema; FK target: Unknown. Use to join season-level facts and dimensions. FK to 'soccer_2016.Match.Season_Id'.
Integer ID of the season’s Man of the Series award recipient. Reference key for the award winner; FK target: Unknown.
Integer ID of the season’s Orange Cap award recipient. Reference key for the award winner; FK target: Unknown.
Integer ID of the season’s Purple Cap award recipient. Reference key for the award winner; FK target: Unknown.
Calendar year of the season as a 4-digit integer (YYYY). Examples: 2010, 2016.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference dimension for soccer teams/clubs. Grain: one row per team. Key join key: Team_Id. Time scope: Unknown.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: one row per team. Primary key: Team_Id. Team_Id is also used as a foreign key in related tables (exact FK targets: Unknown). No explicit time grain; not modeled as an SCD. Joins: soccer_2016.Team.Team_Id → soccer_2016.Player_Match.Team_Id.

columns.columnDescription: Integer surrogate key for a team/club. Primary key of soccer_2016.Team and join key to related tables; FK target Unknown. FK to 'soccer_2016.Player_Match.Team_Id'.
Official team/club name in plain text (string). Used for display and labeling; capitalization as stored.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference table for toss decisions in schema soccer_2016. Grain: one row per unique toss decision option keyed by Toss_Id; no explicit time scope (atemporal/lookup).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Toss_Id. Joins: use Toss_Id to link to any fact/detail table that records a toss decision (foreign key target: Unknown). No known time grain or units; SCD behavior: Unknown.

columns.columnDescription: Integer identifier for a toss decision; primary key and join key. Foreign key target: Unknown.
Text label describing the toss decision. Examples: Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference entity for soccer match officials (umpires/referees). Grain: one row per umpire. Context: database soccer_2016; no explicit dates in this table (static reference). Key join keys: Umpire_Id (PK) and Umpire_Country (FK to a country lookup, table name unknown).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Umpire_Id. Foreign key: Umpire_Country -> country lookup/dimension (target table name unknown). Typical joins: fact tables referencing an umpire join on Umpire_Id; enrich with country details by joining on Umpire_Country. No stated time grain or SCD behavior; treat as a static reference list.

columns.columnDescription: Surrogate integer identifier for an umpire/referee. Use as the join key to link umpire details to other tables that reference an umpire.
Full name of the umpire/referee, free text (e.g., First Last).
Integer ID for the umpire’s nationality/association. Foreign key to a country lookup/dimension (target table name unknown).

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference entity for venues (stadiums/grounds/arenas) used in the soccer_2016 dataset. Grain: one row per venue. Attributes include the venue’s name and a link to its city; no explicit time fields are present.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Venue_Id. City_Id is a foreign key to a city/dimension table (exact target table name: Unknown); expect many venues per city. Venue_Id is also flagged as a foreign key (target: Unknown). No effective-dating columns; SCD behavior: Unknown. IDs are integers; names are free-text. Joins: soccer_2016.Venue.Venue_Id → soccer_2016.Match.Venue_Id; soccer_2016.Venue.City_Id → soccer_2016.City.City_Id.

columns.columnDescription: Integer identifier for a venue (stadium/ground). Primary key for soccer_2016.Venue; also marked as a foreign key (target: Unknown). Use to join from downstream facts that reference venues. FK to 'soccer_2016.Match.Venue_Id'.
Official venue name as text (e.g., Wembley Stadium, Allianz Arena).
Integer identifier for the city where the venue is located; foreign key to a city table (target: Unknown). Join on City_Id to bring city attributes. FK to 'soccer_2016.City.City_Id'.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference dimension for win types in the soccer_2016 dataset. Entity: win-by (method of victory). Grain: one row per distinct win type; no explicit time scope.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Win_Id. Win_Id is also flagged as a foreign key; target table Unknown. Join key for match/outcome-level facts is Win_Id (equality join). Categorical text; no units. No SCD metadata or time grain indicated.

columns.columnDescription: Integer identifier of the win-by type; primary key for this dimension and a join key used by fact tables. Foreign key target: Unknown.
Text label describing how a match was won (method of victory). Exact value list Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Match-level fact table: one row per match. Captures participating teams, date, season, venue, toss details, outcome, and awards where available.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: 1 row = 1 match. Primary key: Match_Id. Foreign keys: Team_1, Team_2, Toss_Winner, Match_Winner -> team entity (target table: Unknown); Season_Id -> season entity (Unknown); Venue_Id -> venue/stadium entity (Unknown); Toss_Decide -> toss-decision lookup (Unknown); Win_Type -> win-type lookup (Unknown); Outcome_type -> outcome-type lookup (Unknown); Man_of_the_Match -> player entity (Unknown). Time fields: Match_Date (DATE). Units: Win_Margin units Unknown. No SCD noted. Joins: soccer_2016.Match.Match_Id → soccer_2016.Extra_Runs.Match_Id; soccer_2016.Match.Match_Id → soccer_2016.Ball_by_Ball.Match_Id; soccer_2016.Match.Match_Id → soccer_2016.Batsman_Scored.Match_Id; soccer_2016.Match.Match_Id → soccer_2016.Player_Match.Match_Id; soccer_2016.Match.Match_Id → soccer_2016.Wicket_Taken.Match_Id; soccer_2016.Match.Season_Id → soccer_2016.Season.Season_Id; soccer_2016.Match.Venue_Id → soccer_2016.Venue.Venue_Id; soccer_2016.Match.Win_Type → soccer_2016.Win_By.Win_Type.

columns.columnDescription: Unique match identifier (integer). Primary key and join key to related detail tables; downstream FK target Unknown. FK to 'soccer_2016.Extra_Runs.Match_Id'. FK to 'soccer_2016.Ball_by_Ball.Match_Id'.
Identifier for the first-listed team in the matchup (integer). Foreign key; target table Unknown.
Identifier for the second-listed team in the matchup (integer). Foreign key; target table Unknown.
Calendar date of the match (DATE, e.g., 2016-05-21).
Season identifier providing competition/time context (integer). Foreign key; target season table Unknown. FK to 'soccer_2016.Season.Season_Id'.
Identifier of the venue/stadium where the match was played (integer). Foreign key; target venue table Unknown. FK to 'soccer_2016.Venue.Venue_Id'.
Identifier of the team that won the pre-match coin toss (integer). Foreign key; target team table Unknown.
Code for the decision made by the toss winner (integer). Foreign key to a toss-decision lookup; target Unknown. Values Unknown.
Categorical code describing how the match was decided (integer). Foreign key to a win-type lookup; target Unknown. Values Unknown. FK to 'soccer_2016.Win_By.Win_Type'.
Numerical margin of victory (integer). Units Unknown.
Outcome category code for the match (integer). Foreign key to an outcome-type lookup; target Unknown. Values Unknown.
Identifier of the winning team (integer). Foreign key; target team table Unknown.
Identifier of the player awarded Man/Player of the Match (integer). Foreign key; target player table Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Ball-by-ball delivery events for cricket matches. Grain: one row per single delivery (ball) within an over of a specific innings in a match; time scope Unknown.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: per delivery within a match innings, located by Match_Id + Innings_No + Over_Id + Ball_Id. Joins: Match_Id is a foreign key to the match-level table (target table name Unknown). Team_Batting, Team_Bowling, Striker, Non_Striker, and Bowler are integer identifiers; FK targets Unknown. No timestamp columns; time scope Unknown. All IDs and positions are integers. Joins: soccer_2016.Ball_by_Ball.Match_Id → soccer_2016.Match.Match_Id.

columns.columnDescription: Unique identifier of the match. Join key to the match master table (target Unknown). Integer, e.g., 1023. FK to 'soccer_2016.Match.Match_Id'.
Over number within the innings for this delivery. Integer, e.g., 1, 12, 20.
Ball (delivery) sequence number within the over. Integer, e.g., 1–6.
Innings sequence number within the match for this delivery. Integer, e.g., 1 or 2.
Identifier of the batting team on this ball. Integer team ID; FK target Unknown.
Identifier of the bowling/fielding team on this ball. Integer team ID; FK target Unknown.
Batting order position number of the striker for this delivery. Integer, e.g., 1, 3, 7.
Identifier of the batter on strike for this delivery. Integer player ID; FK target Unknown.
Identifier of the non-striker (the other batter) at this delivery. Integer player ID; FK target Unknown.
Identifier of the bowler who delivered the ball. Integer player ID; FK target Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Ball-level scoring facts for cricket matches. Grain: one record per delivery identified by Match_Id, Innings_No, Over_Id, and Ball_Id; time scope Unknown.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: Match_Id + Innings_No + Over_Id + Ball_Id (natural key; no explicit PK provided). Join: Match_Id is a foreign key to the match entity (target table Unknown). Over_Id and Ball_Id are scoped within Innings_No for a given Match_Id. Units: Runs_Scored is an integer count of runs on the delivery; inclusion of extras vs bat-only is Unknown. No SCD behavior. Joins: soccer_2016.Batsman_Scored.Match_Id → soccer_2016.Match.Match_Id.

columns.columnDescription: Identifier of the match. Foreign key to the match entity (target table Unknown). Use to join with match-level metadata. FK to 'soccer_2016.Match.Match_Id'.
Over sequence number within the innings of a match. Integer index that resets each innings.
Ball (delivery) sequence number within the over. Integer index that resets each over.
Integer count of runs recorded for this delivery. Scope (batsman-only vs total including extras) is Unknown.
Innings number within the match for Match_Id. Integer index of the innings.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Associative entity linking players to specific matches in the soccer_2016 dataset. Grain: one record per player appearance in a given match, including the team represented and a role identifier for that appearance. Time scope: Unknown (match date/time available via join to the match entity). Key join keys: Match_Id, Player_Id, Team_Id, Role_Id.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: one row per player per match (with team and role for that match). Joins: Match_Id -> match entity (FK), Player_Id -> player entity (FK), Team_Id -> team entity (FK), Role_Id -> role/position entity (FK); exact target table names Unknown. Time context comes from the joined match. All identifiers are integers. No SCD behavior known. Joins: soccer_2016.Player_Match.Match_Id → soccer_2016.Match.Match_Id; soccer_2016.Player_Match.Player_Id → soccer_2016.Player.Player_Id; soccer_2016.Player_Match.Role_Id → soccer_2016.Rolee.Role_Id; soccer_2016.Player_Match.Team_Id → soccer_2016.Team.Team_Id.

columns.columnDescription: Identifier of the match (integer). Foreign key to the match entity; join key to retrieve match-level attributes such as date, competition, venue, and score. Target table name: Unknown. FK to 'soccer_2016.Match.Match_Id'.

Identifier of the player (integer). Foreign key to the player entity; join key to get player details (e.g., name, nationality, squad number). Target table name: Unknown. FK to 'soccer_2016.Player.Player_Id'.

Identifier for the player's role in this match (integer). Meaning of role codes is Unknown; typically represents position or lineup role for the appearance. Foreign key to a role/position entity; target table name: Unknown. FK to 'soccer_2016.Rolee.Role_Id'.
Identifier of the team the player represented in the match (integer). Foreign key to the team/club entity; target table name: Unknown. FK to 'soccer_2016.Team.Team_Id'.
