trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Row grain: 1 row per immunization event per patient per date. Time grain: DATE is a calendar date (no time-of-day). Join keys: PATIENT -> patients (patient identifier; exact target column Unknown); ENCOUNTER -> encounters (encounter/visit identifier; exact target column Unknown). CODE is an immunization code; coding system Unknown. Joins: synthea.immunizations.PATIENT → synthea.encounters.PATIENT; synthea.immunizations.PATIENT → synthea.allergies.PATIENT; synthea.immunizations.PATIENT → synthea.careplans.PATIENT; synthea.immunizations.PATIENT → synthea.conditions.PATIENT; synthea.immunizations.PATIENT → synthea.medications.PATIENT; synthea.immunizations.PATIENT → synthea.observations.PATIENT; synthea.immunizations.PATIENT → synthea.procedures.PATIENT; synthea.immunizations.PATIENT → synthea.claims.PATIENT; synthea.immunizations.ENCOUNTER → synthea.allergies.ENCOUNTER; synthea.immunizations.ENCOUNTER → synthea.careplans.ENCOUNTER; synthea.immunizations.ENCOUNTER → synthea.conditions.ENCOUNTER; synthea.immunizations.ENCOUNTER → synthea.medications.ENCOUNTER; synthea.immunizations.ENCOUNTER → synthea.observations.ENCOUNTER; synthea.immunizations.ENCOUNTER → synthea.procedures.ENCOUNTER; synthea.immunizations.ENCOUNTER → synthea.claims.ENCOUNTER.

columns.columnDescription: Administration date of the immunization event; calendar date only (YYYY-MM-DD). Use as the event date for time-based analyses.

Patient identifier for whom the immunization was administered. Foreign key to the patients entity (exact target table/column: Unknown). FK to 'synthea.encounters.PATIENT'. FK to 'synthea.allergies.PATIENT'.

Clinical encounter/visit identifier during which the immunization occurred; nullable if administered outside a documented visit. Foreign key to encounters (exact target table/column: Unknown). FK to 'synthea.allergies.ENCOUNTER'. FK to 'synthea.careplans.ENCOUNTER'.
Integer immunization/vaccine code identifying the product administered. Coding system: Unknown.
Human-readable vaccine name/description corresponding to CODE. Examples: Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Medication-level records for individual patients, capturing each medication instance linked to a care encounter. Grain: one row per patient–medication (often per encounter) with date-level start and stop boundaries.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Joins: PATIENT -> patients (patient master); ENCOUNTER -> encounters (visit/encounter context). Time fields are date-only (no time-of-day). Codes are integers; coding systems for CODE and REASONCODE are Unknown. DESCRIPTION/REASONDESCRIPTION provide human-readable labels. Joins: synthea.medications.PATIENT → synthea.encounters.PATIENT; synthea.medications.PATIENT → synthea.allergies.PATIENT; synthea.medications.PATIENT → synthea.careplans.PATIENT; synthea.medications.PATIENT → synthea.conditions.PATIENT; synthea.medications.PATIENT → synthea.immunizations.PATIENT; synthea.medications.PATIENT → synthea.observations.PATIENT; synthea.medications.PATIENT → synthea.procedures.PATIENT; synthea.medications.PATIENT → synthea.claims.PATIENT; synthea.medications.ENCOUNTER → synthea.allergies.ENCOUNTER; synthea.medications.ENCOUNTER → synthea.careplans.ENCOUNTER; synthea.medications.ENCOUNTER → synthea.conditions.ENCOUNTER; synthea.medications.ENCOUNTER → synthea.immunizations.ENCOUNTER; synthea.medications.ENCOUNTER → synthea.observations.ENCOUNTER; synthea.medications.ENCOUNTER → synthea.procedures.ENCOUNTER; synthea.medications.ENCOUNTER → synthea.claims.ENCOUNTER.

columns.columnDescription: Calendar date the medication began (YYYY-MM-DD); onset/activation date for the therapy or prescription.
Calendar date the medication ended or was discontinued (YYYY-MM-DD). Null indicates no end date recorded.
Patient identifier for whom the medication applies; FK to patients. Join key to bring patient demographics/context. FK to 'synthea.encounters.PATIENT'. FK to 'synthea.allergies.PATIENT'.
Encounter identifier associated with the medication (e.g., visit where prescribed or managed); FK to encounters. FK to 'synthea.allergies.ENCOUNTER'. FK to 'synthea.careplans.ENCOUNTER'.
Medication concept code (integer). Coding system: Unknown. Use with DESCRIPTION for interpretability.
Human-readable medication name/strength/form when available (free text).
Code representing the clinical reason/indication for the medication. Coding system: Unknown. Pairs with REASONDESCRIPTION.
Text description of the clinical reason/indication for prescribing or administering the medication.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Clinical observations for patients, including vitals and lab-like measurements. Grain: one record per observation concept measured on a given DATE for a PATIENT, typically linked to an ENCOUNTER.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Joins: use PATIENT to link to synthea.patients; use ENCOUNTER to link to synthea.encounters. Multiple observations can occur on the same DATE for a patient and within an encounter. Interpret VALUE together with CODE and UNITS; units vary by concept and may be null for unitless scales. No slowly changing dimensions. Joins: synthea.observations.PATIENT → synthea.encounters.PATIENT; synthea.observations.PATIENT → synthea.allergies.PATIENT; synthea.observations.PATIENT → synthea.careplans.PATIENT; synthea.observations.PATIENT → synthea.conditions.PATIENT; synthea.observations.PATIENT → synthea.immunizations.PATIENT; synthea.observations.PATIENT → synthea.medications.PATIENT; synthea.observations.PATIENT → synthea.procedures.PATIENT; synthea.observations.PATIENT → synthea.claims.PATIENT; synthea.observations.ENCOUNTER → synthea.allergies.ENCOUNTER; synthea.observations.ENCOUNTER → synthea.careplans.ENCOUNTER; synthea.observations.ENCOUNTER → synthea.conditions.ENCOUNTER; synthea.observations.ENCOUNTER → synthea.immunizations.ENCOUNTER; synthea.observations.ENCOUNTER → synthea.medications.ENCOUNTER; synthea.observations.ENCOUNTER → synthea.procedures.ENCOUNTER; synthea.observations.ENCOUNTER → synthea.claims.ENCOUNTER.

columns.columnDescription: Calendar date the observation was recorded or took effect (YYYY-MM-DD). Useful for time-window filtering and ordering within encounters.
Patient identifier for whom the observation applies. Foreign key to the patient entity in synthea.patients. FK to 'synthea.encounters.PATIENT'. FK to 'synthea.allergies.PATIENT'.
Encounter identifier during which the observation was captured. Foreign key to synthea.encounters (visit/episode). FK to 'synthea.allergies.ENCOUNTER'. FK to 'synthea.careplans.ENCOUNTER'.
Standardized clinical code representing the observation concept. Terminology system: Unknown.
Human-readable name for the observation concept matching CODE. Examples: Systolic blood pressure, Hemoglobin A1c, Body mass index.
Numeric result of the observation. Interpreted with UNITS and CODE. Examples: 120, 98.6, 5.4.
Unit of measure for VALUE (text). Examples: mmHg, mg/dL, %, bpm, kg/m2. May be null for unitless observations.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Clinical procedures performed for patients. Grain: one procedure event per row, typically tied to a specific patient and encounter on a calendar date. Time scope: date-only (no time-of-day). Join keys: PATIENT to patients, ENCOUNTER to encounters.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Joins: PATIENT -> synthea.patients (on PATIENT), ENCOUNTER -> synthea.encounters (on ENCOUNTER). Event time grain is date-only. Coding systems for CODE/REASONCODE are Unknown. Multiple procedures may occur within the same encounter and date. Joins: synthea.procedures.PATIENT → synthea.encounters.PATIENT; synthea.procedures.PATIENT → synthea.allergies.PATIENT; synthea.procedures.PATIENT → synthea.careplans.PATIENT; synthea.procedures.PATIENT → synthea.conditions.PATIENT; synthea.procedures.PATIENT → synthea.immunizations.PATIENT; synthea.procedures.PATIENT → synthea.medications.PATIENT; synthea.procedures.PATIENT → synthea.observations.PATIENT; synthea.procedures.PATIENT → synthea.claims.PATIENT; synthea.procedures.ENCOUNTER → synthea.allergies.ENCOUNTER; synthea.procedures.ENCOUNTER → synthea.careplans.ENCOUNTER; synthea.procedures.ENCOUNTER → synthea.conditions.ENCOUNTER; synthea.procedures.ENCOUNTER → synthea.immunizations.ENCOUNTER; synthea.procedures.ENCOUNTER → synthea.medications.ENCOUNTER; synthea.procedures.ENCOUNTER → synthea.observations.ENCOUNTER; synthea.procedures.ENCOUNTER → synthea.claims.ENCOUNTER.

columns.columnDescription: Calendar date the procedure was performed or recorded; day precision (YYYY-MM-DD).
Patient identifier for whom the procedure applies; foreign key to synthea.patients. FK to 'synthea.encounters.PATIENT'. FK to 'synthea.allergies.PATIENT'.
Encounter/visit identifier during which the procedure occurred; foreign key to synthea.encounters. FK to 'synthea.allergies.ENCOUNTER'. FK to 'synthea.careplans.ENCOUNTER'.
Numeric procedure code for the event. Coding system: Unknown.
Human-readable name of the procedure corresponding to CODE. Examples: imaging study, biopsy, vaccination.
Code representing the clinical reason/indication for the procedure. Coding system: Unknown.
Text description of the clinical reason/indication for the procedure corresponding to REASONCODE.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Healthcare claim header entity at the claim level. Each row represents one claim for a single patient, optionally linked to an encounter and an organization, with a billable service date.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: 1 row per claim (primary key: ID). Potential join keys: PATIENT -> patient entity; ENCOUNTER -> encounter entity; ORGANIZATION -> organization entity (exact target tables unknown). Time: BILLABLEPERIOD is a single calendar date; start/end of period unknown. Units: TOTAL is an integer; currency and scale (dollars vs cents) unknown.

columns.columnDescription: Unique claim identifier; primary key for synthea.claims.
Identifier of the patient associated with the claim; join key to the patient entity (target table unknown).
Service/billing date for the claim (YYYY-MM-DD). Single date within the billable period; time zone and whether start/end are represented are unknown.
Identifier of the organization tied to the claim (e.g., billing/responsible organization); join key to an organization entity (target table unknown). Whether this is payer or provider is unknown.
Identifier of the encounter or visit from which the claim originates; join key to the encounter entity (target table unknown).
Diagnosis reference or code linked to the claim. Format/coding system unknown (may be a clinical code or an internal identifier).
Total claim amount as an integer. Currency and unit scale are unknown (e.g., dollars vs cents). Example: 1250.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Gene-level classification table linking each gene to a localization attribute. Grain: one row per GeneID with its localization classification; time scope: Unknown (no effective dating present). Key join key: GeneID.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: GeneID; Foreign key: GeneID -> Unknown target table in the 'genes' database; Grain: 1 row per GeneID classification; No SCD/effective-dated fields; Localization is a categorical text label (units N/A). Joins: genes.Classification.GeneID → genes.Genes.GeneID.

columns.columnDescription: Unique gene identifier; primary key for genes.Classification and foreign key to an Unknown target table. Text key used to join with other gene-centric tables. FK to 'genes.Genes.GeneID'.
Localization classification for the gene. Unknown scope and coding.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Gene-level attributes. One record per gene identifier (grain: gene). Time scope unknown; no effective-dating columns are present.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: one row per GeneID (may not be unique; deduplicate as needed). Join key: GeneID (foreign key to a gene reference; target Unknown). Time scope: Unknown; no validity/start-end dates. Chromosome is an integer index; numbering scheme Unknown. Joins: genes.Genes.GeneID → genes.Classification.GeneID.

columns.columnDescription: Alphanumeric identifier for a gene; case-sensitive key used to join with other gene-related tables. Foreign key target: Unknown. FK to 'genes.Classification.GeneID'.
Essentiality flag indicating whether the gene is required for viability under standard conditions. Coding scheme Unknown (e.g., yes/no or 1/0).
Gene classification or category. Scheme Unknown.
Associated protein complex name or identifier. Unknown.
Observed phenotype linked to the gene (e.g., from perturbation or mutation studies). Vocabulary Unknown.
Sequence or regulatory motif associated with the gene or its promoter. Details Unknown.
Chromosome index where the gene is located; integer (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Numbering scheme and organism Unknown.
Functional annotation or role of the gene product. Unknown format.
Cellular or subcellular localization of the gene product. Vocabulary Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Gene-level interaction edges. Grain: one record per pair of genes (GeneID1, GeneID2) with an interaction Type and an optional Expression_Corr score. No timestamps are present; time scope Unknown. Join to gene metadata using GeneID1 and GeneID2.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Joins: GeneID1 and GeneID2 are foreign keys to a gene reference/entity table (target table Unknown); join on the gene identifier. Time: no date/time columns; snapshot/time scope Unknown. Units: Expression_Corr is a unitless correlation coefficient, expected range roughly [-1, 1]; exact statistic (Pearson/Spearman) Unknown. Directionality of pairs (whether GeneID1→GeneID2 implies order) Unknown.

columns.columnDescription: Foreign key gene identifier for the first gene in the pair. Text ID; identifier scheme Unknown. Join key to the gene entity (target table Unknown).
Foreign key gene identifier for the second gene in the pair. Text ID; identifier scheme Unknown. Join key to the gene entity (target table Unknown).
Classification of the interaction between GeneID1 and GeneID2. Allowed values and definitions Unknown.
Correlation coefficient between expression profiles of GeneID1 and GeneID2; unitless. Exact statistic Unknown; values typically range from -1 (anti-correlated) to 1 (positively correlated).

trainingdata.tableDescription: Customer/client master in the retail domain. Grain: one row per unique customer identified by c_custkey. No effective-dating fields are present; time scope Unknown.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Keys: Primary key c_custkey. Foreign keys: c_nationkey -> nation/country reference (target table Unknown); c_custkey is also flagged as a foreign key (target Unknown). No explicit time grain (snapshot). Units/format notes: c_acctbal currency Unknown; c_phone format Unknown.

columns.columnDescription: Surrogate integer identifier for the customer. Primary key for retails.customer; also flagged as a foreign key (target Unknown). Use as the join key to customer-related facts/dimensions.
Marketing segment/category assigned to the customer. Controlled vocabulary; values Unknown.
Integer reference to the customer's nation/country record. Foreign key; target table Unknown.
Customer name text. May represent a person or organization; casing/format Unknown.
Free-form mailing/street address for the customer. Structure and components (street, city, region, postal code) Unknown.
Customer telephone number as text. Country/area code and formatting conventions Unknown.
Account balance for the customer as a decimal number. Currency/units Unknown (e.g., could be monetary).
Free-text notes or comments about the customer. Content and format Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Order line items for retail orders, capturing quantities, pricing, discounts/taxes, shipping details, and notes. Grain: one record per order line within an order (line item). Time scope includes ship, commit/promise, and receipt dates at day-level. Key join keys: l_orderkey (order header), l_partkey (part/product), l_suppkey (supplier), with l_linenumber identifying the line within the order.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Joins: l_orderkey → order header (target table name Unknown), l_partkey → part/product (Unknown), l_suppkey → supplier/vendor (Unknown). Line locator within an order: l_linenumber (often used with l_orderkey). Date fields are day-grain (no time-of-day). Currency and units are Unknown; l_discount and l_tax scale (rate vs amount) is Unknown.

columns.columnDescription: Calendar date the line item was shipped/dispatched. Date in YYYY-MM-DD.
Order identifier for the parent order header. Foreign key; target table Unknown. Commonly used with l_linenumber to reference a specific line.
Discount applied to this line. Scale is Unknown (rate vs amount).
Extended line amount (typically quantity × unit price). Currency Unknown.
Supplier identifier for the vendor fulfilling this line. Foreign key; target table Unknown.
Ordered quantity for this line. Unit Unknown; integer.
Return status flag for the line. Code values Unknown.
Product/part identifier for the item on this line. Foreign key; target table Unknown.
Operational status code for the line item. Values Unknown.
Tax applied to this line. Scale is Unknown (rate vs amount).
Committed/promise date for shipment or delivery of this line. Date in YYYY-MM-DD.
Date the receipt/delivery of this line was recorded. Date in YYYY-MM-DD.
Shipping mode or method used for this line (e.g., ground, air). Values Unknown.
Sequential line number within the order identified by l_orderkey (1, 2, 3…).
Special shipping instructions for this line. Free text; values Unknown.
Free-form comment or note about the line item. Text.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference dimension of nations (countries). Each row represents a single nation with a surrogate identifier and a link to a parent region; no time component (static reference).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: 1 row per nation/country. PK: n_nationkey. FK: n_regionkey (target table/column Unknown). No time grain/SCD behavior noted.

columns.columnDescription: Surrogate integer identifier for the nation/country; primary key for retails.nation. Join key to link from fact or other dimension tables. Examples: 1, 2, 3.
Official nation/country name in text. Examples: Canada, Brazil, Germany.
Integer foreign key linking the nation to its parent region. FK target table/column: Unknown.
Optional free-text notes about the nation/country. Examples: data quality notes, historical context.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Retail order header entity with one row per order (grain: o_orderkey). Captures order attributes such as date, status, priority, customer link, and total value; time field is a DATE (no time component). Key join keys: o_orderkey (primary key; also marked as FK per metadata) and o_custkey (FK to customer entity; target table Unknown).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: 1 row per order. Primary key: o_orderkey. Foreign keys: o_custkey -> customer entity (target Unknown); o_orderkey is also flagged as a FK in metadata (target Unknown). Dates are DATE (no time zone). Currency for o_totalprice is Unknown. Status/priority fields are categorical; code lists Unknown.

columns.columnDescription: Calendar date the order was placed/created. DATE in YYYY-MM-DD; no time component.
Unique order identifier (integer). Primary key for retails.orders; used as join key to related order-detail data. Also marked as a foreign key in metadata; target Unknown.
Customer identifier linked to the order (integer). Foreign key to a customer entity; exact target table Unknown.
Priority assigned to the order for fulfillment/handling. Text label or code; scale Unknown.
Shipping priority code/rank for delivery sequencing. Integer; scale/meaning Unknown.
Identifier or name of the clerk/agent who entered or managed the order. Format Unknown.
Lifecycle status of the order. Text code or label; allowed values Unknown.
Total monetary amount for the order at header level. Decimal currency; currency Unknown; inclusion of tax/discount Unknown.
Free-text notes or comments about the order, e.g., special instructions or customer remarks.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference catalog of parts/products. Grain: one row per part (entity = product part) keyed by p_partkey; no explicit time scope/effective dates.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: p_partkey. Join to related tables on p_partkey (FK targets: Unknown). No SCD fields or dates present. Monetary currency: Unknown. Size units: Unknown.

columns.columnDescription: Surrogate integer identifier for the part. Primary key and also used as a foreign key in other tables (target: Unknown) for joins.
Categorical descriptor of the part’s type or category. Value set: Unknown.
Integer size attribute of the part. Unit: Unknown (dimension/capacity not specified).
Brand label under which the part is marketed. Free text; examples and allowed set: Unknown.
Human‑readable product/part name as shown in catalogs or listings. May include model or attributes.
Packaging/container description for the unit of sale. Value set and units: Unknown.
Manufacturer (maker) of the part. Free text; not necessarily the seller. Allowed set: Unknown.
Retail/list price for one part unit. Currency: Unknown; decimal amount.
Free‑text notes or comments about the part. Content/format: Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Part–supplier link detailing which suppliers provide which parts, with pricing and available quantity at the supplier. Grain: one row per Part × Supplier pairing; time scope: Unknown (no effective dates present).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Joins: use ps_partkey to join to the Part entity (FK) and ps_suppkey to join to the Supplier entity (FK). Uniqueness is typically by the combination (ps_partkey, ps_suppkey). Monetary amounts have currency: Unknown; quantities are counts of units. SCD: Unknown.

columns.columnDescription: Identifier of the Part in this part–supplier pairing. Integer. Foreign key to the Part entity (target table: Unknown). Use as join key to Part.
Identifier of the Supplier providing the part. Integer. Foreign key to the Supplier entity (target table: Unknown). Use as join key to Supplier.
Unit cost charged by the supplier for the part in this pairing. Decimal currency amount (currency: Unknown). Example: 42.50.
Quantity the supplier makes available for this part; unit is count of items. Integer. Example: 500.
Free-text notes about the part–supplier relationship (e.g., lead-time or quality remarks).

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference list of geographic regions in the retails database. Entity/grain: one row per region. Time scope: static reference (no effective dating present). Key join key: r_regionkey.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: r_regionkey. Join to related tables on r_regionkey where present. No time grain or SCD attributes indicated; treat as a static reference.

columns.columnDescription: Unique integer identifier for a region. Primary key of retails.region; also marked as a foreign key in the model (target: Unknown). Use to join with tables carrying r_regionkey or a matching region key.
Human-readable name/label of the region (text).
Optional free-text notes or remarks about the region.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Master list of suppliers. Grain: one row per supplier identified by s_suppkey. No effective-dating fields are present; temporal scope unknown. Key join keys: s_suppkey (supplier identifier) and s_nationkey (links supplier to a nation/country record).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: s_suppkey. Foreign keys: s_nationkey -> nation/country lookup (target table unknown); metadata also flags s_suppkey as a FK (target unknown). No timestamps provided; treat as a snapshot. Monetary amounts in s_acctbal have unspecified currency and sign convention.

columns.columnDescription: Unique identifier for the supplier. Primary key for retails.supplier; also referenced as a foreign key in other tables (target Unknown). Example: 12345.
Identifier of the supplier’s nation/country record. Foreign key; exact target table Unknown. Use to join to a nation/country table for country name and region. Example: 15.
Free‑text notes or remarks about the supplier (e.g., “Preferred vendor for Q3”, “On hold”).
Supplier’s legal or trading name. Examples: “ABC Supplies Co.”, “Global Parts Ltd”.
Supplier mailing/street address as a single string; may include street, city, state/province, and postal code. Example: “123 Main St, Springfield, IL 62704”.
Supplier contact phone number including area/country code when available. Examples: “+1-415-555-0123”, “020 7946 0018”.
Monetary account balance associated with the supplier (currency and sign convention Unknown). Decimal amount, e.g., 1000.50 or -250.00.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference list of applications (apps) in the TalkingData domain. Grain: one row per app identified by app_id; no explicit time scope.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: 1 row per app_id. Primary key: app_id. app_id also acts as a foreign key to related app mapping/usage tables (target Unknown). No timestamps; not an SCD. Joins: talkingdata.app_all.app_id → talkingdata.app_events.app_id; talkingdata.app_all.app_id → talkingdata.app_events_relevant.app_id; talkingdata.app_all.app_id → talkingdata.app_labels.app_id.

columns.columnDescription: Unique integer identifier of an application (app). Primary key for app_all and also used as a foreign key in related app mapping tables (FK target: Unknown). FK to 'talkingdata.app_events.app_id'. FK to 'talkingdata.app_events_relevant.app_id'.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Entity: app references linked to individual mobile events. Grain: one record per (event_id, app_id) pair indicating the app’s presence/status for that event. Time scope: no timestamps in this table; event timing is associated with the referenced event via event_id.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: one row per event_id + app_id. Join: event_id is a foreign key to the parent event record (target table Unknown in this catalog). Time: no native timestamp; use the joined event’s time if needed. Coding: is_installed and is_active are integer flags typically using 0/1. Joins: talkingdata.app_events.event_id → talkingdata.events.event_id; talkingdata.app_events.event_id → talkingdata.events_relevant.event_id; talkingdata.app_events.app_id → talkingdata.app_all.app_id.

columns.columnDescription: Identifier of the parent event; foreign key to the event record (FK target: Unknown). Join key to link app details for a specific event. FK to 'talkingdata.events.event_id'. FK to 'talkingdata.events_relevant.event_id'.

Identifier of the application associated with the event. Integer ID used to group by app or to join to app-level metadata if available. Examples: 123456789, 987654321. FK to 'talkingdata.app_all.app_id'.
Integer indicator showing whether the app was installed on the device at the time of the event. Examples: 1 (installed), 0 (not installed); null may occur.
Integer indicator showing whether the app was active at the time of the event (e.g., running/in use). Examples: 1 (active), 0 (inactive); null may occur.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Event–app linkage for TalkingData. Grain: one record per (event_id, app_id) indicating whether the app was installed and active for that event; time context is per event (exact timestamp, if needed, should come from the event entity).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Joins: event_id is a FK to the event entity (target table: Unknown); app_id is a FK to the app catalog (target table: Unknown). Row grain: unique per (event_id, app_id) pair. Flags: is_installed and is_active are integer-coded booleans (1=yes, 0=no). Time scope: event-level; join via event_id for any timestamps. Joins: talkingdata.app_events_relevant.event_id → talkingdata.events.event_id; talkingdata.app_events_relevant.event_id → talkingdata.events_relevant.event_id; talkingdata.app_events_relevant.app_id → talkingdata.app_all.app_id.

columns.columnDescription: Foreign key for the event associated with this app linkage. Integer identifier; examples: 123456789. FK target: Unknown. FK to 'talkingdata.events.event_id'. FK to 'talkingdata.events_relevant.event_id'.
Foreign key for the application referenced in the event. Integer app catalog identifier; examples: 100967, 20345. FK target: Unknown. FK to 'talkingdata.app_all.app_id'.
Binary flag indicating whether the app was installed on the device at the time of the event. Integer-coded: 1=yes, 0=no.
Binary flag indicating whether the app was active during the event (e.g., running/in use). Integer-coded: 1=yes, 0=no.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Associative mapping of applications to label identifiers. Entity: app–label relationship; grain: one row per (app_id, label_id) pair. Time scope: Unknown; no timestamp columns present.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: one row per app_id + label_id (many-to-many bridge). Joins: app_id → application entity (exact target table Unknown); label_id → label metadata/definitions (exact target table Unknown). No time grain or units; not an SCD. Joins: talkingdata.app_labels.app_id → talkingdata.app_all.app_id; talkingdata.app_labels.label_id → talkingdata.label_categories.label_id.

columns.columnDescription: Opaque integer identifier for an application; join key across TalkingData app-related tables. FK to the application entity (target table Unknown). Examples: 1005966, 2034519. FK to 'talkingdata.app_all.app_id'.

Integer identifier for a label/tag assigned to the app; join key to label definitions. FK to label metadata (target table Unknown). Examples: 47, 302, 1205. FK to 'talkingdata.label_categories.label_id'.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Event-level fact table capturing device-generated events with optional geolocation. Grain: one row per event_id (a single event occurrence for a device at a specific timestamp). Timezone and coverage period: Unknown. Key joins likely via device_id; event_id may be referenced by downstream tables.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: 1 row per event_id. Primary key: event_id. Foreign keys: event_id marked as FK (target Unknown); device_id commonly used to join to a device reference table (target Unknown). Time: timestamp is an instant; timezone Unknown. Location: latitude/longitude are decimal degrees (lat −90..90, lon −180..180). Joins: talkingdata.events.event_id → talkingdata.events_relevant.event_id.

columns.columnDescription: Unique integer identifier for an event record. Primary key of talkingdata.events; also flagged as a foreign key (target table: Unknown). Example: 123456789. FK to 'talkingdata.events_relevant.event_id'.
Identifier of the device that generated the event. Stable across events for the same device; used as a join key to a device reference table (target: Unknown). Example: 35832107.
Datetime when the event occurred. Timezone: Unknown. Example: 2016-11-18 07:34:21.
Geographic longitude at event time in decimal degrees (−180 to 180). East positive, west negative. Example: 116.4074.
Geographic latitude at event time in decimal degrees (−90 to 90). North positive, south negative. Example: 39.9042.

Includes incident datetime (text), block-level location, offense/classification codes, geocoordinates, and administrative area identifiers. Key join keys include iucr_no, fbi_code_no, district_no, ward_no, and community_area_no. Time scope Unknown.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: report_no. Foreign keys: iucr_no (IUCR offense code), fbi_code_no (FBI classification), district_no (police district), ward_no (city ward), community_area_no (community area); target lookup tables Unknown. Time grain: per-incident datetime in 'date' (text; format/timezone Unknown). Latitude/longitude are text fields intended to hold decimal degrees. Joins: chicago_crime.Crime.iucr_no → chicago_crime.IUCR.iucr_no; chicago_crime.Crime.district_no → chicago_crime.District.district_no; chicago_crime.Crime.ward_no → chicago_crime.Ward.ward_no; chicago_crime.Crime.community_area_no → chicago_crime.Community_Area.community_area_no; chicago_crime.Crime.fbi_code_no → chicago_crime.FBI_Code.fbi_code_no.

Agency case identifier associated with the report. Alphanumeric text; uniqueness over time Unknown.
Incident date and time as text. Exact format/timezone Unknown.
Street block of the incident location (address masked to block level). Text.

Short text describing the place/premise where the incident occurred. Examples could include types of places; specific values Unknown.
Flag indicating whether an arrest was made in connection with the incident. Boolean-like; encoding (e.g., Y/N or true/false) Unknown.
Flag indicating whether the incident was domestic-related. Boolean-like; encoding Unknown.
Numeric identifier for the police patrol beat where the incident occurred. Integer.
Police district number corresponding to the location of the incident. Integer. Foreign key to a district lookup (target table Unknown). FK to 'chicago_crime.District.district_no'.
City ward number for the incident location. Integer. Foreign key to a ward lookup (target table Unknown). FK to 'chicago_crime.Ward.ward_no'.
Community area identifier for the incident location. Integer. Foreign key to a community area lookup (target table Unknown). FK to 'chicago_crime.Community_Area.community_area_no'.
FBI crime classification code associated with the incident. Text. Foreign key to an FBI code lookup (target table Unknown). FK to 'chicago_crime.FBI_Code.fbi_code_no'.
Latitude of the incident location in decimal degrees (text).
Longitude of the incident location in decimal degrees (text).

trainingdata.tableDescription: Borders between pairs of countries. Grain: one row per country pair representing a shared border, with an optional numeric length. Time scope: Unknown. Join keys: Country1 and Country2 (country identifiers).

Identifier or name of the second country in the border pair; intended as a join key to the same country reference entity as Country1. Exact identifier type and target table: Unknown.
Length of the shared border between Country1 and Country2. Unit Unknown (numeric; e.g., 750 indicates a border 750 units long).

trainingdata.tableDescription: Cities with name, country/province context, approximate population, and geographic coordinates. Grain: one record per city/urban place; population reflects a snapshot, reference year unknown.

columns.columnDescription: Official or common city name. Examples: Paris, São Paulo, Tokyo.
Country in which the city is located (text name). Examples: France, Brazil, Japan.
First‑level administrative subdivision containing the city (e.g., state/region/province). Examples: Île-de-France, California, Ontario.
Resident population count (people). Point-in-time snapshot; reference year unknown. Example: 1245789.
City center longitude in decimal degrees (east positive, west negative). Examples: 2.3522, -77.0365.
City center latitude in decimal degrees (north positive, south negative). Examples: 48.8566, -23.5505.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Geographic reference for continents. Grain: one record per continent; entity = continent. No time dimension indicated; treated as a static lookup. Primary join key is Name.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Name. Use Name for joins where other tables reference a continent by name. Area unit not specified; confirm units before aggregations or comparisons. No explicit foreign keys defined.

columns.columnDescription: Continent name (primary key). Examples: Africa, Asia, Europe.
Total surface area of the continent. Units: Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Country-level reference table in schema mondial_geo. Grain: one row per country, keyed by Code. Intended for geographic lookups of name, capital, area, and population; time scope is Unknown (no effective dates provided).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Code. One row per country. Units: Population = persons; Area unit = Unknown. No declared foreign keys and no valid-from/valid-to columns (snapshot). Join to other country-level tables, when present, by Code.

columns.columnDescription: Country name in plain text. Examples: France, Japan.
Country code (primary key). Code system/length Unknown (e.g., US or USA). Use to join with other country-level data keyed by country code.
Capital city name of the country. Text label only; relationship to a city table is Unknown.
Administrative subdivision associated with the capital (e.g., province/state/region). Exact definition is Unknown.
Total area of the country; unit Unknown (numeric, may include decimals).
Total population count in persons. As-of date is Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Geographic reference table of deserts, with one record per named desert. Contains surface area and point coordinates (latitude and longitude); time scope is Unknown. Primary join key is Name.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Name. No foreign keys declared. No time dimension (static reference; time scope Unknown). Units: Area units Unknown; Latitude/Longitude units Unknown and the exact reference point (centroid vs representative point) is Unknown.

columns.columnDescription: Common name of the desert; unique within this dataset and used as the primary key for joins.
Surface area of the desert. Units: Unknown.
Longitude coordinate associated with the desert. Units and reference point are Unknown.
Latitude coordinate associated with the desert. Units and reference point are Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Country-level economy metrics by nation. Grain: one row per Country; time scope unknown (no year/date provided). Includes GDP, sectoral measures (Agriculture, Industry, Service), and Inflation. Join to other subject areas via the Country name key.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Country. Join key: Country (text name) to other tables that use the same country naming. Units not specified: do not assume currency or percentages for GDP or sector fields; Inflation unit also unknown. No time grain provided; values may represent an unspecified reference period. No SCD behavior described.

columns.columnDescription: Country name serving as the row identifier. Example values: Unknown. Use as join key to country-level tables.
Gross domestic product for the country. Units: Unknown.
Agriculture sector measure for the country. Units: Unknown.
Service sector measure for the country. Units: Unknown.
Industry sector measure for the country. Units: Unknown.
Inflation for the country (rate of general price change). Units: Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Country–continent coverage mapping. Each row links a country to a continent with the percentage of that country’s territory in that continent. Grain: one record per Country–Continent pair. Time scope: no effective date captured (Unknown recency).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Natural composite key: (Country, Continent). Join keys: Country and Continent to related geographic reference tables if present. Percentage is a percent from 0–100; values for a given Country typically sum to ~100 across its continents; decimals allowed. No SCD fields/time grain provided.

columns.columnDescription: Country identifier within this schema; used with Continent to define the coverage pair. Format (name vs code): Unknown.
Continent name for the pairing. Typical values include Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, Oceania, Antarctica.
Share of the country’s territory lying in the specified Continent, expressed as a percentage (0–100). Decimals allowed; e.g., Turkey–Europe ≈ 3.0, Turkey–Asia ≈ 97.0.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Ethnic composition by country. Grain: one row per (Country, Name) ethnic group within a country; no reference year provided (time scope: Unknown). Use Country as the key to join to the country entity.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain is (Country, Name). Join guidance: link Country to the country entity in the same database; exact target table/field is Unknown. Percentages are in percent units and may not sum to 100 within a country. No explicit time dimension; treat as an undated snapshot.

columns.columnDescription: Country identifier for which the ethnic group share applies; used to join to the country entity (exact target table/field: Unknown). Format (name or code) is Unknown.
Ethnic group name within the specified country. Examples: Han Chinese, Arab, Berber.
Share of the country's total population belonging to the named group; unit: percent (0–100, decimals allowed).

trainingdata.tableDescription: Geographic mapping of deserts to the countries and first-level administrative areas (provinces/states/regions) they occupy. Grain: one record per Desert–Country–Province association (a desert may appear in multiple countries and multiple provinces within a country). Time scope: Unknown.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: Desert–Country–Province association. Join keys (if reference tables exist): Desert (desert name), Country (country name), Province (admin-1 name within Country). All fields are text; joins should be name-based and case/diacritic-insensitive. No SCD; units are geographic names.

columns.columnDescription: Common name of the desert referenced in this record. Examples: Sahara, Gobi, Atacama.
Name of the sovereign country containing part or all of the desert. Examples: Algeria, China, Chile.
First-level administrative area (province/state/region) within the listed country where the desert lies. Examples: Xinjiang, Balochistan, Western Australia.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Estuary reference for rivers: each record identifies where a river meets the sea/ocean within a political area. Grain: one row per river estuary by Country and, when available, Province/first‑order division. No time dimension is indicated; treated as a static geographic reference. Join keys are name-based: River, Country, and Province (text).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: river estuary by Country and optional Province (admin1). No explicit PK/FK in provided metadata; name-based joins may apply where matching reference tables exist (targets Unknown). All fields are text; no units. No timestamps or SCD behavior indicated.

columns.columnDescription: Canonical name of the river whose estuary location is described. Text name used for name-based joins to river reference data (target Unknown).
Country in which the river’s estuary lies. Text country name suitable for name-based joins to a country dimension (target Unknown).
First‑order administrative division (e.g., state, province, region) containing the estuary, if applicable. May be null when the estuary is not within a named admin1 unit or not recorded.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Geospatial reference of islands and their administrative context. Grain: one record per island name with its associated country and, when available, a first‑level subdivision (province/state/region). Time scope: Unknown (no effective dates present).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: No explicit PK/FK defined. Row grain is island × country (with optional province). Text values; capitalization and naming variants may occur. Time grain: none (snapshot).

columns.columnDescription: Name of the island (geographic feature). Free-text label; not guaranteed globally unique.
Country that administers or contains the island. Text name of the sovereign state.
First-level administrative division within the country that the island belongs to (e.g., province/state/region). May be null.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Geographic reference of lakes by political area. Entity: lake location. Grain: one row per Lake–Country–Province (first-order admin unit) combination. Time scope: static geography; effective date Unknown.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: No declared PK/FK. Typical joins, if present elsewhere: Country -> country dimension by country name; (Country, Province) -> admin-1 region dimension by names. Use exact text matches; casing/diacritics handling Unknown. Units are names (text); no measures. No SCD behavior noted.

columns.columnDescription: Proper name of the lake/waterbody. Examples: Lake Superior, Lake Victoria, Titicaca. Text only; not an ID.
Country where the lake (or a portion of it) lies. Example values: Canada, Peru, Tanzania. Text name; coding standard Unknown.
First-order administrative division containing the lake segment (province/state/region). Examples: Ontario, Sichuan, Michigan. Join key typically pairs with Country.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference list of mountains with their associated country and optional first‑level administrative division. Grain: one row per mountain-place context (Mountain within Country, optionally Province). No explicit time attributes; time scope Unknown.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: No declared primary key; deduplication/uniqueness Unknown (Mountain + Country + Province commonly used to disambiguate names). Joins: Country can join to a country reference table by name; (Country, Province) can join to an administrative-division table if available. No time grain; units not applicable.

columns.columnDescription: Common name of the mountain/peak. Text; may include diacritics or multiword names. Use together with Country/Province to distinguish homonymous peaks.
Sovereign country containing the mountain. Text name; coding/standardization Unknown. Join key to a country table by country name when available.

First-level subnational division within Country where the mountain lies (e.g., province/state/region). Presence and naming standard Unknown; null when not applicable or unknown. Can join to an administrative-division table by (Country, Province) if present.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Geographic linkage between rivers and administrative areas. Each row associates a river name with a country and, when available, a province/state within that country; no time attributes are present.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: one record per (River, Country, Province) association; Province may be null. No declared primary or foreign keys in the provided schema. All fields are text names (no codes). No time dimension; not time-variant.

columns.columnDescription: Proper name of the river. Text name; not a code.
Country name associated with the river. Text name of the nation.
Administrative subdivision within the country related to the river (e.g., province/state/region). Text name; may be null.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Geographic reference linking marine water bodies to political areas. Grain: one record per Sea–Country–Province coastal adjacency (Province may be null when not modeled). Time scope: static reference geography with no effective dates. Key join keys are the name fields Sea, Country, and Province.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: No declared primary or foreign keys. Suggested natural key: Sea + Country + Province (Province may be null). Joins are typically name-based to other mondial_geo reference tables (e.g., country or province admin levels, sea catalogs); validate spelling/diacritics before joining. Static dataset; no time grain. Text values are plain names (no codes or units).

columns.columnDescription: Name of the marine water body bordering the listed area; may include seas, gulfs, bays (text). Examples: Mediterranean Sea, Bay of Bengal, Gulf of Mexico.
Country that has a coastline on Sea (text name). Examples: Italy, India, Mexico.
First-level administrative division within Country that borders Sea (text). Examples: British Columbia, Sicilia, Andalusia. Null when not applicable or not modeled.

trainingdata.tableDescription: River source locations. Each row links a river to the country and first-level administrative division (province/state/region) containing its headwaters. Grain: river-by-source location (river × country × province). No time scope captured.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: No declared PK/FK. Typical joins use natural names: River to a rivers list, Country to a countries reference, Province to an admin‑1 reference, if present elsewhere. All fields are plain-text names; no units or dates.

columns.columnDescription: Name of the river whose headwaters/source are referenced. Text label; potential natural join key to a river reference, if available.
Country containing the river’s source location. Text country name; standard/code Unknown. Natural join candidate to a countries reference.
First-level administrative division of the country (province/state/region) where the source lies. Text name; coding scheme Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Geospatial reference for islands. Grain: one row per island identified by Name; includes area, maximum height, classification, and latitude/longitude. Time scope: Unknown.

columns.columnDescription: Proper name of the island; primary key for this table and the natural join key to any related island mapping tables if present.
Island group or archipelago the island belongs to, if applicable. Text label; not a declared foreign key.
Surface area of the island. Units: Unknown.
Maximum elevation on the island. Units: Unknown.
Classification of the island (e.g., volcanic, coral, continental). Exact value set: Unknown.
Geographic longitude of the island’s reference point in degrees. Datum and sign convention: Unknown.
Geographic latitude of the island’s reference point in degrees. Datum and sign convention: Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Relationship table mapping each island to the enclosing water body. Grain: one row per Island linked to exactly one named Sea, Lake, or River (others may be NULL). trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Joins by matching names: Island to mondial_geo.island; Sea to mondial_geo.sea; Lake to mondial_geo.lake; River to mondial_geo.river. Typically only one of Sea, Lake, or River is populated per row; the others are NULL. No time grain; all values are place names (strings).

columns.columnDescription: Island name referenced in this relationship; join key to mondial_geo.island.

Name of the lake containing the island; join to mondial_geo.lake. NULL when the island is in a sea or river.
Name of the river containing the island; join to mondial_geo.river. NULL when the island is in a sea or lake.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Membership link between a country and an organization. Grain: one row per Country–Organization pairing (optionally differentiated by Type). No effective dates are present; historical time scope is Unknown.

Organization the country is affiliated with, typically an international or regional body. Text; examples: United Nations, European Union, ASEAN. Join key to an organization reference table if available.
Membership classification or status within the organization. Examples: full member, associate member, observer.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Global lake entities with physical attributes and location. Grain: one record per lake (named inland water body), no time dimension. Primary key is Name; use it to join with other datasets that reference lakes by name.

Surface area of the lake. Units: Unknown (check source before comparing or aggregating).

Elevation of the lake surface above sea level. Units: Unknown.
Classification of the lake (semantics of categories are Unknown).

Longitude of the lake location in decimal degrees (range roughly -180 to 180). Datum: Unknown.
Latitude of the lake location in decimal degrees (range roughly -90 to 90). Datum: Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Language usage by country. Grain: one row per Country–Name (language) pair with the share of the country's population attributed to that language. Time scope: Unknown. Key join key for integration is Country.

columns.columnDescription: Country identifier or name for which the language share is reported. Intended as the join key to country reference data; code system/format Unknown.
Language name associated with the specified country. Whether this is endonym/exonym or standardized naming is Unknown.
Share of the country’s population associated with the language. Unit: percent (0–100); decimals allowed. Whether this reflects native speakers vs. total speakers is Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Associative geography table linking a city to nearby water bodies. Entity: a city–waterbody relationship. trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Joins: use City + Province + Country to disambiguate the city when joining to a city reference table (target table name: Unknown). Waterbody links can be matched on River, Lake, or Sea names to corresponding reference tables if present (targets: Unknown). No time grain; values are textual names. SCD: none. Country in which the City is located (text name of the sovereign state). Joins with City and Province to form the city key.

Lake associated with the City (city situated on the lakeshore or adjacent to this lake). Null if not applicable. Can be used to join to a lake reference table; FK target: Unknown.
Sea or coastal water body associated with the City (e.g., coastal location or port on this sea). Null if not applicable. Can be used to join to a sea reference table; FK target: Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Association entity linking geographic places to the islands they are located on. Grain: one record per place–island relationship (place can be at city, province, or country level). Static geography; no time scope.

One-to-many possible: a place can map to multiple islands (archipelagos), and an island can host multiple places. No explicit PK/FK or time columns.

columns.columnDescription: City name that is located on the referenced Island. Text label of a municipality; may be accompanied by Province and Country for context. FK target: Unknown.
First-order administrative division tied to the place on the Island (e.g., state/province/region). May identify the province itself or provide context for a City. FK target: Unknown.
Country identifier for the place on the Island. Text; exact format Unknown (could be name or code). FK target: Unknown.
Name of the island on which the place lies. Text label of the island entity. FK target: Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Sea-to-sea relationship table capturing where one sea merges or connects with another. Grain: one record per pair (Sea1, Sea2); static geographic fact with no time scope. Join keys: Sea1 and Sea2 (text sea names).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: No declared primary or foreign keys. Join guidance: if a sea reference/dimension exists, join on Sea1 and Sea2 by sea name. No time grain or SCD behavior. Values are plain-text sea names.

columns.columnDescription: Name of the first sea in the merging pair (text). Examples: Mediterranean Sea, Black Sea. Can act as a join-by-name key to a sea reference entity if available.
Name of the second sea in the merging pair (text). Examples: Aegean Sea, Caribbean Sea. Can act as a join-by-name key to a sea reference entity if available.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Entity: individual mountains/peaks with basic attributes and coordinates. Grain: one record per mountain (unique by Name); no time dimension indicated.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Name. No foreign keys declared. Coordinates are in decimal degrees; coordinate reference system: Unknown. Height unit: Unknown. No time fields; dataset appears as a static snapshot.

columns.columnDescription: Canonical mountain/peak name; primary key for this table and typical join key from other entities that reference a mountain by name. Examples: Mount Everest, Mont Blanc.

Classification of the mountain. Examples: volcano, peak, massif. Controlled list: Unknown.

Geographic latitude of the mountain’s reference point in decimal degrees. Datum/CRS: Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Entity: associations of mountains located on islands in the mondial_geo schema. trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: 1 row per mountain–island association. Time scope: Unknown. Joins: if reference tables for mountains and islands exist in the dataset, join on name equality using Mountain and Island. No SCD behavior; values are plain text names.

columns.columnDescription: Name of the mountain/peak located on the island (text). Intended as a name-based join key to a mountains reference table, if available. Units: n/a.
Name of the island on which the mountain is located (text). Intended as a name-based join key to an islands reference table, if available. Units: n/a.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference list of organizations. Grain: one record per organization identified by Abbreviation, with name, associated location (city/province/country), and the date it was established. Attributes are largely static; Established reflects the founding date.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Abbreviation. Grain: one row per organization. Time scope: static reference; Established is a single calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). No declared foreign keys.

columns.columnDescription: Short code or acronym uniquely identifying the organization; primary key. Examples: UN, EU, NATO, WHO.
Official full name of the organization in plain text. Example: United Nations.
City associated with the organization (e.g., headquarters or registration city). Role not specified; free-text city name. Examples: New York, Geneva.
Country name corresponding to the associated city/province for the organization. Examples: United States, Switzerland.
First-level administrative division (state/province/region) for the associated city, if applicable. Examples: California, Bavaria, Ontario.
Calendar date the organization was founded/established (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: 1945-10-24.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Country/territory political attributes at the country level. One row per Country capturing independence date, dependency relationship (if any), and government type; overall time scope unknown (snapshot of the source). The primary join key is Country (country name).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: one record per country or territory. Primary key: Country. No declared foreign keys. Date values use calendar dates (ISO-8601). Government is free-text and may vary in phrasing; treat case-insensitively. Dependent may be null/blank for fully sovereign states; when present it names the sovereign/parent state.

columns.columnDescription: Country or territory name (likely English common name). Serves as the primary key and join key to other country-level datasets. Examples: France, Brazil, Greenland.
Date the country attained independence/sovereignty. Format: date (e.g., 1776-07-04, 1947-08-15). May be null for non-sovereign dependencies.
Name of the sovereign or parent state if the entity is a dependency; null/empty when fully independent. Examples: Denmark (for Greenland), United Kingdom (for Bermuda).
Textual classification of the government type or political system. Examples: parliamentary republic, constitutional monarchy, federal republic, single-party state.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Country-level demographics focusing on population growth and infant mortality. Grain: one row per country; no explicit year or period provided (time scope unknown). Use Country as the key to link with country reference data where available.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: 1 row per country. Primary key: Country. Time: no date column; effective period unknown. Joins: use Country (country name) to join to country reference tables by name; target table not specified. Units for rates are not provided by the source.

columns.columnDescription: Country name serving as the row key (entity: country). Join key to country reference/lookup datasets by name; note name normalization may be required. Time scope: Unknown.
Population growth rate for the country. Unit: Unknown (numeric rate). Higher values indicate faster growth.
Infant mortality rate for the country. Unit: Unknown (numeric rate). Represents deaths among infants under age 1 relative to births.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Subnational administrative provinces within countries. Grain: one row per province in a given country; no time scope provided. Use Country + Name as the natural identifier; attributes include population, area, and capital details.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: one row per province within a Country; no effective dates or SCD. Joins: identify a province by (Country, Name); capital city matching may use (Capital, Country, CapProv) if cities are keyed by province. Units: Population=persons; Area=Unknown.

columns.columnDescription: Official province name as text. Examples: Ontario, Sichuan.
Country to which the province belongs (text). Examples: Canada, China.
Total population of the province (persons). Reference year: Unknown.
Geographic area size of the province. Units: Unknown.
Name of the province’s capital city (administrative seat). Examples: Toronto, Chengdu.
Province name associated with the capital city (the capital’s province). Useful for disambiguating capitals that need a province qualifier.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Country-level religious composition. Each row represents a Country–Name pair with the share of adherents in that country. No date fields are present; time scope is Unknown. The main join key is Country (country name text).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: one row per Country × Name (religion/denomination). Time scope: Unknown (no effective date). Units: Percentage is a percent value from 0 to 100. Joins: use Country (country name) to link to a country reference table; exact target Unknown. No SCD behavior indicated.

columns.columnDescription: Country name; text label used for joining to country metadata (target table Unknown). Examples: France, Brazil.

Body weight in pounds. Integer value (no decimals), e.g., 203; inverse of kilograms via 1 lb ≈ 0.453592 kg.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Player-level draft and bio attributes for ice hockey. One row per player identified by ELITEID, with static profile fields (name, birth details, physicals, position, shoots) and draft context plus 7-year aggregate outcomes.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: 1 record per player (ELITEID). Joins: ELITEID is the primary key and also appears as a foreign key across related tables (exact target Unknown); columns height and weight are flagged as FKs but targets Unknown. Time scope: draftyear is a calendar year; 7-year aggregates (sum_7yr_*) use a 7-year window with anchor and league scope Unknown. Units: height/weight/TOI units Unknown. SCD/versions: Unknown. Joins: ice_hockey_draft.PlayerInfo.ELITEID → ice_hockey_draft.SeasonStatus.ELITEID; ice_hockey_draft.PlayerInfo.height → olympics.person.height; ice_hockey_draft.PlayerInfo.height → hockey.Master.height; ice_hockey_draft.PlayerInfo.height → professional_basketball.players.height; ice_hockey_draft.PlayerInfo.weight → olympics.person.weight; ice_hockey_draft.PlayerInfo.weight → shipping.shipment.weight; ice_hockey_draft.PlayerInfo.weight → hockey.Master.weight; ice_hockey_draft.PlayerInfo.weight → professional_basketball.players.weight; ice_hockey_draft.PlayerInfo.weight → cars.data.weight.

Player’s full name as plain text.
Full date of birth; text format Unknown.
Year component of the player’s birthdate; date type, exact representation Unknown.

Birthplace as free text; could include city/region/country. Structure Unknown.
Player nationality or country. Format Unknown (name or code).

Player body weight; units Unknown. Marked as foreign key; target Unknown. FK to 'olympics.person.weight'. FK to 'shipping.shipment.weight'.
Playing position detail. Coding/format Unknown (e.g., abbreviations or full names).
Shooting side/handedness. Representation Unknown (e.g., L/R or full words).

Draft round number; integer.
Overall draft pick number; integer.
