Cumulative time on ice over a 7-year window; integer. Time unit Unknown (minutes/seconds) and league scope Unknown.
Indicator for whether games played exceeds 0 in the 7-year window; text values Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Season-level hockey stat lines by ELITEID for a specific SEASON, TEAM, LEAGUE, and GAMETYPE. Grain: one record per ELITEID x SEASON x TEAM x LEAGUE x GAMETYPE, capturing totals for that season segment.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Join: ELITEID is a foreign key to an elite reference entity (target table: Unknown). Grain: ELITEID + SEASON + TEAM + LEAGUE + GAMETYPE. Time scope: season segment (e.g., Regular Season, Playoffs). Units: GP/G/A/P are counts; PIM is minutes; Plus/Minus is an integer rating; Points = Goals + Assists. Joins: ice_hockey_draft.SeasonStatus.ELITEID → ice_hockey_draft.PlayerInfo.ELITEID.

columns.columnDescription: Foreign key identifying the elite entity for the stat line. Join target: Unknown. Examples: 12345. FK to 'ice_hockey_draft.PlayerInfo.ELITEID'.
Season identifier for the stats. Typical formats: YYYY-YY or YYYY (text). Examples: 2019-20, 2021.
Team name or abbreviation for which the stats were recorded in that season segment. Examples: BOS, Boston Bruins.
League name or code associated with the team and season. Examples: NHL, AHL, SHL.
Season segment for the stats, e.g., Regular Season, Playoffs, Preseason. Common abbreviations: RS, PO.
Number of games appeared in during the specified season segment (ELITEID x SEASON x TEAM x LEAGUE x GAMETYPE). Integer count, e.g., 82.
Goals scored in the specified season segment. Integer, e.g., 35.
Assists credited in the specified season segment. Integer, e.g., 47.
Total points in the season segment. Defined as Goals + Assists. Integer, e.g., 82.
Penalty minutes assessed over the season segment. Minutes, integer, e.g., 12.
Plus/minus rating for the season segment; net on-ice goal differential while the player is on the ice. Integer; can be negative. Examples: -3, 12.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Country/territory dimension for the World Development Indicators (WDI). One record per country or aggregate; mostly static metadata with some fields indicating the latest available reference year. Key join key is CountryCode, used to link country metadata to indicator datasets across this database.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: CountryCode (also used as FK to related WDI tables). Grain: 1 row per country/territory or aggregate; no explicit time grain. Year-like fields contain a 4-digit calendar year when available. Many categorical fields (Region, IncomeGroup, LendingCategory, etc.) are standardized taxonomies; values may be blank for aggregates or special areas. Joins: world_development_indicators.Country.CountryCode → world.City.CountryCode; world_development_indicators.Country.CountryCode → world.CountryLanguage.CountryCode; world_development_indicators.Country.CountryCode → world_development_indicators.Indicators.CountryCode.

columns.columnDescription: Primary country/territory code used by WDI (typically 3 letters, e.g., USA, IND, BRA). Join key to other WDI tables on CountryCode. FK to 'world.City.CountryCode'. FK to 'world.CountryLanguage.CountryCode'.
Common short country/territory name used in displays. Examples: United States, India, Brazil.
Display-friendly name for tabular outputs or headings. Often mirrors ShortName.
Official or extended country/territory name. Examples: United States of America, Federative Republic of Brazil.
Two-letter country/territory code (e.g., US, IN, BR).
Official currency unit used for national accounts and reporting (text). Examples: US dollar, euro, naira.
Free-text notes on country coverage, breaks, or methodological specifics.
WDI regional grouping for the country/territory (categorical).
WDI income classification (e.g., Low income, Lower middle income, Upper middle income, High income).
Two-character World Bank country shorthand code; often matches the two-letter code.
Base year used for constant-price national accounts (format: YYYY when available). Example: 2015.
Reference year or index base for national accounts series (YYYY or notation such as 2010=100).
Valuation basis used in the System of National Accounts (e.g., market prices, basic prices, producer prices).
World Bank lending classification for the economy (e.g., IDA, IBRD, Blend, Non-borrower).
Other analytical or regional group memberships (text; may include multiple tags).
Version of the System of National Accounts adopted (e.g., SNA 2008, SNA 1993).
Notes on use of an alternative conversion/exchange factor in national accounts (text).
Most recent International Comparison Program purchasing power parity survey year (YYYY). Examples: 2011, 2017.

columns.cleaned_name: Balance of Payments Manual in Use
columns.columnDescription: Balance of Payments Manual version followed (e.g., BPM6, BPM5).
columnAlias: balance of payments manual in use

columns.columnDescription: Status of reporting external debt data to relevant systems (e.g., full, partial, not reporting).
Trade reporting system used (e.g., general trade system or special trade system).
Government finance accounting basis/standard (e.g., cash or accrual basis; GFSM variants).

columns.cleaned_name: International Monetary Fund Data Dissemination Standard
columns.columnDescription: IMF data dissemination standard participation (e.g., GDDS, e-GDDS, SDDS, SDDS Plus).
Year of the most recent population census (YYYY) where available.
Name and/or year of the most recent household survey (text). Example: HIES 2018/19.

columns.cleaned_name: Source of Most Recent Income and Expenditure Data
columns.columnDescription: Source description for the latest household income/expenditure data (text; e.g., HBS/HIES name and year, agency).
columnAlias: source of most recent income and expenditure data

columns.columnDescription: Whether the civil/vital registration system is complete (e.g., Yes/No).
Year of the most recent agricultural census (YYYY).
Latest year with available industrial statistics (YYYY). Example: 2019.
Latest year with available merchandise trade statistics (YYYY). Example: 2021.
Latest year with available water withdrawal statistics (YYYY). Example: 2015.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Metadata for World Development Indicators (entity: indicator series). Grain: one row per indicator series identified by SeriesCode; no time dimension in this table. Use SeriesCode as the primary key and as the join key to any observation/value tables that hold time-series data for these indicators.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: SeriesCode. Join to fact/observation tables on SeriesCode (one-to-many from Series to observations). No time grain; content is descriptive metadata. UnitOfMeasure and BasePeriod define how to interpret numeric values in related observations; compare indicators only when units/base are compatible. Periodicity indicates typical reporting frequency, not a date field. Review LicenseType before redistribution.

columns.columnDescription: Unique identifier for an indicator series. Primary key for this table and common join key to indicator value tables; typically a dot-delimited code string.
Thematic category for the indicator series used for browsing and grouping (e.g., economic growth, health, education).
Human-readable title of the indicator series, such as a descriptive phrase a user would search for.
Brief summary of what the indicator measures, typically one to two sentences.
Detailed definition of the indicator, including scope, construction (e.g., numerator/denominator), and key measurement notes.
Measurement unit for values of this indicator. Examples: percent (%), number of people, US dollars (current or constant), index (base year = 100).
Standard reporting frequency for this series. Examples: annual, quarterly, monthly.
Reference period for index-type indicators. Examples: 2015=100, 2000 base year.
Unknown.
How values are aggregated (e.g., to regional/global totals or across subcomponents). Examples: weighted average, simple average, sum.
Caveats, known data gaps, breaks in series, and exceptions that affect comparability across countries or over time.
Notes provided by the original data source, including footnotes and release notes.
Editorial comments or context to aid interpretation of the indicator.
Data provider or compilation source for the indicator (e.g., a national statistical office or international organization).
Explanation of the statistical concepts, classifications, and calculation methodology used for the indicator.
Why the indicator matters for development policy, monitoring, or decision-making.
URL links to documentation, source pages, or further reading related to the indicator.
Unknown.
Unknown.
Usage license or terms for the indicator and its metadata (e.g., public domain, open license, or restricted).

trainingdata.tableDescription: Country-level notes for specific World Development Indicators (WDI) series. Grain: one record per Countrycode and Seriescode; no year dimension is present, so notes apply generally to that country–indicator pair.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: 1 row per Countrycode + Seriescode. Joins: Countrycode joins to the country reference used across WDI (target table: Unknown); Seriescode joins to the WDI series/indicator catalog (target table: Unknown). No explicit time key; treat as non-time-stamped metadata. Joins: world_development_indicators.CountryNotes.Countrycode → world_development_indicators.Footnotes.Countrycode; world_development_indicators.CountryNotes.Seriescode → world_development_indicators.Footnotes.Seriescode; world_development_indicators.CountryNotes.Seriescode → world_development_indicators.SeriesNotes.Seriescode.

columns.columnDescription: Country identifier used across WDI; 3-letter code format. Examples: USA, IND, BRA. Foreign key (target table: Unknown). FK to 'world_development_indicators.Footnotes.Countrycode'.

WDI indicator/series identifier. Examples: SP.POP.TOTL (population), NY.GDP.MKTP.CD (GDP current US$). Foreign key (target table: Unknown). FK to 'world_development_indicators.Footnotes.Seriescode'. FK to 'world_development_indicators.SeriesNotes.Seriescode'.
Free-text country-specific note for the given series, e.g., coverage limitations, breaks in series, or methodology. Examples: "Excludes overseas departments"; "Break in series in 2015".

trainingdata.tableDescription: Footnotes and annotations linked to development indicator data. Grain: one note per combination of Countrycode (country/entity), Seriescode (indicator/series), and Year (calendar year text), with the possibility of multiple notes for the same combination. Join keys commonly used: Countrycode and Seriescode.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Time grain: yearly (Year as text, typically 4-digit). Joins: Countrycode -> Unknown (country/entity lookup), Seriescode -> Unknown (indicator/series lookup). Grain: 1+ footnotes per Countrycode–Seriescode–Year. Joins: world_development_indicators.Footnotes.Countrycode → world_development_indicators.CountryNotes.Countrycode; world_development_indicators.Footnotes.Seriescode → world_development_indicators.CountryNotes.Seriescode; world_development_indicators.Footnotes.Seriescode → world_development_indicators.SeriesNotes.Seriescode.

columns.columnDescription: Country/entity identifier the footnote applies to; text code (format unknown). Foreign key to a country/entity dimension (target table: Unknown). FK to 'world_development_indicators.CountryNotes.Countrycode'.

Indicator/series identifier the footnote refers to; text code. Foreign key to a series/indicator dimension (target table: Unknown). FK to 'world_development_indicators.CountryNotes.Seriescode'. FK to 'world_development_indicators.SeriesNotes.Seriescode'.
Calendar year the footnote pertains to; stored as text. Typical values: '1960', '2000', '2019'.
Free-text footnote content explaining data nuances (e.g., break in series, methodology change, estimate, revision).

trainingdata.tableDescription: Country–indicator time-series fact table at annual grain. Each row represents one numeric observation for a given CountryCode, IndicatorCode, and Year.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: one row per CountryCode + IndicatorCode + Year (natural key). Time grain: annual (calendar year). Joins: CountryCode -> countries/regions reference (target: Unknown); IndicatorCode can be used to join to indicator metadata if available (target: Unknown). Units for Value depend on IndicatorCode and are not standardized here. Joins: world_development_indicators.Indicators.CountryCode → world_development_indicators.Country.CountryCode.

columns.columnDescription: Display name of the country or region. Examples: United States, India, World. Use with CountryCode for unambiguous joins.
Short code identifying the country or region. Foreign key to a countries/regions lookup (target: Unknown). Examples: USA, IND, WLD. FK to 'world_development_indicators.Country.CountryCode'.
Descriptive title of the development indicator corresponding to IndicatorCode. Examples: GDP (current US$), Population, total.
Identifier code for the development indicator; use to align with indicator metadata if present. Example format: NY.GDP.MKTP.CD.
Calendar year of the observation (YYYY). Examples: 1990, 2010, 2020.
Numeric observation for the indicator in the specified country and year (integer per schema). Unit depends on IndicatorCode; Unknown here. Null indicates missing data.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Notes linked to a World Development Indicators series by year. Grain: one record per Seriescode and Year with the note text applicable to that indicator in that calendar year. Join key: Seriescode (foreign key to series/indicator metadata; target table Unknown).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain is Seriescode + Year (annual). Seriescode is a foreign key to the series/indicator master; exact target table Unknown. Year is stored as text; typical values are 4-digit calendar years. Joins: world_development_indicators.SeriesNotes.Seriescode → world_development_indicators.CountryNotes.Seriescode; world_development_indicators.SeriesNotes.Seriescode → world_development_indicators.Footnotes.Seriescode.

columns.columnDescription: Identifier of the indicator (series) the note pertains to. Foreign key; target table Unknown. Use as the join key to link notes to series metadata. FK to 'world_development_indicators.CountryNotes.Seriescode'. FK to 'world_development_indicators.Footnotes.Seriescode'.
Calendar year the note applies to (text). Typical format: 4-digit year, e.g., 2015; exact format Unknown.
Free-text note for the given Seriescode and Year, e.g., methodological changes, definitions, or data caveats. Units: not applicable.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference table of air carriers (airlines). Grain: one record per carrier code. No effective dating is present; serves as a static lookup mapping an integer code to a carrier description. Join to related airline data via Code.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Code. Code is also a foreign key referenced by other airline tables; exact target table: Unknown. Grain: one row per carrier code. No SCD/effective-dating columns; treat as a non-temporal lookup. Joins: airline.Air Carriers.Code → world.Country.Code; airline.Air Carriers.Code → mondial_geo.country.Code; airline.Air Carriers.Code → airline.Airports.Code.

columns.columnDescription: Integer identifier for an air carrier (airline). Primary key for this table and a foreign key into related airline datasets (target: Unknown). Use as the join key to link carrier attributes to facts. FK to 'world.Country.Code'. FK to 'mondial_geo.country.Code'.
Carrier name or description corresponding to Code. Exact naming convention: Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference entity: airports. Grain: 1 row per airport identified by Code. Time scope: Unknown (no effective-dating fields provided). Join key: Code.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Grain: one row per airport. Primary key: Code. Code is also used as a foreign key in related airline tables; target table(s): Unknown. Time scope: Unknown; no SCD behavior indicated. Units: not applicable. Joins: airline.Airports.Code → world.Country.Code; airline.Airports.Code → mondial_geo.country.Code; airline.Airports.Code → airline.Air Carriers.Code.

columns.columnDescription: Airport identifier code. Serves as the primary key for Airports and is referenced as a foreign key by other tables (target: Unknown). Code system/format: Unknown. FK to 'world.Country.Code'. FK to 'mondial_geo.country.Code'.
Human-readable airport name or description (e.g., full airport name or label). Exact format, language, and components: Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Flight leg facts for commercial airline operations. Grain appears to be one record per operating carrier’s flight leg on a given FL_DATE between an origin and destination; uniqueness is not guaranteed. Time scope includes the operating date and local times for departure and arrival.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Likely joins: OP_CARRIER_AIRLINE_ID to a carrier/airline dimension (target table Unknown); ORIGIN and DEST to an airport dimension by airport code (target table Unknown). Candidate composite keys for scoping a leg: FL_DATE + OP_CARRIER_AIRLINE_ID + OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM + ORIGIN + DEST (not guaranteed unique). Times in CRS_DEP_TIME/DEP_TIME/ARR_TIME are integers in HHMM local time. Elapsed times are minutes. Delay columns are minutes; sign conventions may vary by field; where noted, negative values indicate early arrival/departure. Cancellation encoding and reason code set are Unknown.

columns.columnDescription: Operating flight date. Text format; typically an ISO-like date (e.g., 2021-01-31). Time zone basis Unknown.
Numeric ID of the operating airline/carrier. Foreign key; target table Unknown.
Aircraft registration/tail number (e.g., N12345). Identifies the physical aircraft used for the leg.
Published flight number assigned by the operating carrier; integer (e.g., 1234).
Numeric identifier for the origin airport. Coding scheme Unknown.
Numeric sequence identifier for the origin airport. Exact meaning/usage Unknown.
Numeric identifier for the origin city market/metro area. Definition Unknown.
Origin airport code for the leg (coding standard Unknown; often a 3-letter IATA code). Foreign key; target table Unknown.
Numeric identifier for the destination airport. Coding scheme Unknown.
Numeric sequence identifier for the destination airport. Exact meaning/usage Unknown.
Numeric identifier for the destination city market/metro area. Definition Unknown.
Destination airport code for the leg (coding standard Unknown; often a 3-letter IATA code). Foreign key; target table Unknown.
Scheduled local departure time at origin in HHMM 24-hour format (e.g., 1730).
Actual local departure time at origin in HHMM 24-hour format (e.g., 1748).
Departure delay in minutes relative to scheduled departure (CRS_DEP_TIME). Negative = early; positive = late.
Departure delay in minutes, alternate/non-negative variant. Exact derivation Unknown.
Actual local arrival time at destination in HHMM 24-hour format.
Arrival delay in minutes relative to scheduled arrival. Negative = early; positive = late.
Arrival delay in minutes, alternate/non-negative variant. Exact derivation Unknown.
Cancellation indicator for the flight leg. Encoding Unknown (commonly 1=cancelled, 0=not cancelled).
Code indicating the reason for cancellation. Code set Unknown.
Scheduled gate-to-gate elapsed time in minutes (scheduled block time).
Actual gate-to-gate elapsed time in minutes (actual block time).
Minutes of delay attributed to the airline/carrier. Attribution rules Unknown.
Minutes of delay attributed to weather. Attribution rules Unknown.
Minutes of delay attributed to the NAS/airspace/ATC. Attribution rules Unknown.
Minutes of delay attributed to security-related causes.
Minutes of delay due to late arrival of the inbound aircraft from the previous leg.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference dimension for geographic states/provinces used in the retail_complains domain. Grain: one row per StateCode; no explicit time fields, so it represents a current snapshot reference. Join to fact/detail tables via StateCode.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: StateCode. StateCode is also flagged as a foreign key; target table is Unknown. Join to other tables on StateCode where present. No time grain columns or SCD indicators; treated as a static lookup. Region is a free-text grouping label; controlled list Unknown. Joins: retail_complains.state.StateCode → regional_sales.Regions.StateCode.

columns.columnDescription: Unique short code for the state/province/territory. Primary key for retail_complains.state and used as the join key to related tables. Foreign key target: Unknown. Text code; format and casing Unknown. FK to 'regional_sales.Regions.StateCode'.
Full name of the state/province/territory corresponding to StateCode. Human-readable label used in reports.
Higher-level geographic grouping for the state (e.g., region/area/zone/division) used for reporting rollups. Exact coding scheme and allowed values: Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Call center interaction logs linked to retail complaints. Grain: one row per Complaint ID representing a call-center log entry, anchored by Date received (date). Key joins include Complaint ID (FK to a complaints entity; target Unknown) and rand client (FK to a client/customer entity; target Unknown).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: Complaint ID (also flagged as a foreign key). Foreign keys: Complaint ID (target Unknown), rand client (target Unknown). Time grain: day-level by Date received; server start/exit/time are text and may require parsing to timestamps; timezone/format Unknown. call id is a call-level identifier but not unique in this table. Phone numbers are free-text; format Unknown. Joins: retail_complains.callcenterlogs.Complaint ID → retail_complains.events.Complaint ID; retail_complains.callcenterlogs.call_id → retail_complains.callcenterlogs.Complaint ID.

columns.columnDescription: Calendar date the complaint/contact was received by the call center. Date only (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: 2023-09-14.

Unique complaint identifier for the case associated with this log entry; primary key for this table. Foreign key to a complaints entity (target Unknown). Examples: alphanumeric case IDs. FK to 'retail_complains.events.Complaint ID'.
Anonymized client/customer identifier tied to the complaint. Foreign key (target Unknown).
Final phone number used for the contact (dialed or callback). Free-text; may include country code. Example: +1 415 555 0199.
VRU/IVR line identifier used in routing. Unknown coding/values.
System-generated identifier for the phone call/interaction. Integer example: 123456. FK to 'retail_complains.callcenterlogs.Complaint ID'.
Numeric priority of the complaint/call. Scale meaning Unknown. Examples: 1, 2, 3.
Unknown. Likely denotes call or complaint type/category.
Unknown. Intended to capture the result/disposition of the interaction.
Server/host identifier that handled the IVR/call flow. Naming scheme Unknown.
Raw value from server logs indicating a start marker for the interaction flow. Stored as text; exact meaning/format Unknown.
Raw value from server logs indicating an exit/end marker for the interaction flow. Stored as text; exact meaning/format Unknown.
Raw server time value related to the interaction. Stored as text; intended as date/time but format/timezone Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Client/customer entity with demographic and contact attributes. Grain: one record per client_id; includes name, sex, age, phone/email, and postal address, plus date components whose business meaning is unspecified.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: client_id. Foreign keys: district_id joins to a district/region lookup (target table unknown); client_id is also flagged as a foreign key (target unknown). Day/month/year are separate date parts (day 1–31, month 1–12, year 4-digit); the referenced event/date is unknown. Zip/postal code is stored as INTEGER; leading zeros may be dropped—cast to text for display. No explicit SCD/versioning columns; update cadence unknown. Joins: retail_complains.client.district_id → retail_complains.district.district_id.

columns.columnDescription: Unique identifier of the client; primary key for this table. Also flagged as a foreign key; target table unknown. Examples: C12345, 8f2a9c17.
Client sex/gender value; coding format unknown. Examples could include M, F, Male, Female.
Day-of-month component (1–31) of an associated client-related date; exact event/date type unknown.
Month component (1–12) of an associated client-related date; exact event/date type unknown.
Calendar year component (four digits) of an associated client-related date; exact event/date type unknown.
Client age in whole years; reference date for calculation unknown. Examples: 25, 42.
Unknown.
Client given/first name. Examples: Maria, John.
Client middle name or middle initial. Examples: Ann, J.
Client family/last name (surname). Examples: Nguyen, Garcia.
Primary contact phone number as text to preserve formatting and country codes. Examples: +1 415 555 2671; (020) 7946 0958.
Client contact email address. Example: alex.smith@example.com.
Street address line 1 (house number and street). Example: 123 Main St.
Additional address line (apartment/suite/unit). Example: Apt 4B.
City or town for the mailing address. Example: San Jose.
State/province/region for the address; may be code or full name. Examples: CA, California.
Postal/ZIP code stored as INTEGER; leading zeros may be lost (e.g., 02115 becomes 2115).
Identifier of the district/administrative area linked to the address; foreign key (target table unknown). FK to 'retail_complains.district.district_id'.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Reference table for geographic districts in the retail_complains database. Grain: one row per district_id; no effective dating provided (time scope Unknown). Key joins: district_id is the primary key and also flagged as a foreign key; state_abbrev is a foreign key (targets Unknown).
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Primary key: district_id (unique per row). Foreign keys: district_id -> Unknown target; state_abbrev -> Unknown target. Grain: 1 row per district_id; no time-versioning indicated (SCD Unknown). Joins: retail_complains.district.district_id → retail_complains.client.district_id; retail_complains.district.district_id → retail_complains.reviews.district_id.

columns.columnDescription: Integer identifier for a district. Primary key of retail_complains.district; also flagged as a foreign key (target table Unknown). Use as the join key to link district-level data. FK to 'retail_complains.client.district_id'. FK to 'retail_complains.reviews.district_id'.
City name associated with the district (text). Exact naming standard/casing Unknown.
State or province abbreviation/code for the district. Format/standard Unknown. Marked as a foreign key; target table Unknown.
Administrative division label that groups districts. Semantics and controlled values Unknown.

trainingdata.tableDescription: Event-level consumer complaint records for the retail_complains domain. Grain: one row per complaint event submitted by a client about a product/issue. Time fields present include Date received and Date sent to company.
trainingdata.tableSpecificRules: Joins: Complaint ID (FK; target table Unknown), Client ID (FK; target table Unknown). Time notes: Date received is a calendar date; Date sent to company is stored as text but represents a calendar date (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD). Booleans are typically captured as Yes/No. SCD: Unknown. Joins: retail_complains.events.Complaint ID → retail_complains.callcenterlogs.Complaint ID.

columns.columnDescription: Calendar date the complaint was received by the intake system. Example: 2025-03-17.
Primary product category the complaint concerns. Specific value set Unknown.
More granular product subtype related to the complaint. Specific value set Unknown.
Primary problem reported by the consumer. Examples Unknown.
More specific problem subtype associated with the Issue. Examples Unknown.
Free-text description written by the consumer about the complaint. May contain multiple sentences and line breaks.
Labels or flags applied to the complaint; may contain multiple values (delimiter Unknown).
Indicates whether the consumer provided consent related to sharing the narrative. Typical values: Yes/No/Unknown.
Channel used to submit the complaint (e.g., web, phone, mail). Exact value list Unknown.
Calendar date the complaint was forwarded to the company; stored as text. Expected format often YYYY-MM-DD; timezone Unknown.
Company’s response category or message back to the consumer. Exact value set Unknown.
Whether the company responded within the required timeframe. Values typically Yes or No.
Whether the consumer disputed the company’s final response. Values typically Yes or No.
External complaint identifier used to join to a complaint-level table (FK target Unknown). FK to 'retail_complains.callcenterlogs.Complaint ID'.
Identifier for the client who submitted the complaint; join key to a client reference table (FK target Unknown).
